explanation_en: Let the number be x. Wrong: x - 16 + 10 = 14, so x = 20. Right answer: x + 16 - 10 = x + 6 = 20 + 6 = 26.

question_en: By how much is 1/4 th of 428 smaller than 5/6 th of 1296?
What is the colour of the alluvial soils and Arid Soils respectively?
option_a_en: Light to ash grey; Red to Brown
option_b_en: Red to Brown; Light to ash grey
explanation_en: Alluvial soil is formed mainly from Himalayan debris or the sediment left by retreating seas. Its colour ranges from light brown to ash grey (light to ash grey). Arid soil ranges from red to brown, is generally sandy, and contains a higher amount of salt.

question_en: Which of the following awards gives 24 awards each year?
explanation_en: The Sahitya Akademi Award is a literary honour established in 1954. The Sahitya Akademi distributes 24 awards each year for literary work in recognised languages and for literary translations in Indian languages. It is the second-highest literary honour given by the Government of India after the Jnanpith Award.

question_en: Which of the following is the active category of the Ramon Magsaysay Award?
explanation_en: The active category of the Ramon Magsaysay Award is 'Emergent Leadership'. Although it began with six categories, it is now an annual award given to individuals and organisations in Asia who have made outstanding contributions to their communities. Often called the Nobel Prize of Asia, it was established in 1957 by the Rockefeller Brothers Fund with the agreement of the Philippine government.

question_en: Arrange the following from north to south: Bibi ka Maqbara, Golconda Fort, Golden Temple.
option_a_en: Bibi ka Maqbara, Golconda Fort, Golden Temple
option_b_en: Golden Temple, Golconda Fort, Bibi ka Maqbara
option_c_en: Golconda Fort, Golden Temple, Bibi ka Maqbara
option_d_en: Golden Temple, Bibi ka Maqbara, Golconda Fort
explanation_en: Arranged from north to south the order is Golden Temple, Bibi ka Maqbara, then Golconda Fort. The Golden Temple is in Amritsar (Punjab), Bibi ka Maqbara is in Aurangabad (Maharashtra), and Golconda Fort is in Hyderabad (Telangana).

question_en: Almost ______ of the world's people live in two continents Asia and Africa?
explanation_en: Almost three-quarters of the world's population lives in Asia and Africa, because these two continents are the largest in the world in terms of both population and area.

question_en: The ratio of nominal to real GDP is a well-known index of prices. This is called as ______.
explanation_en: The GDP Deflator is an index that reflects the change in price levels of all goods and services produced in an economy. It is a broader measure of inflation. In simple terms it measures the change in prices of goods and services produced in a country by comparing nominal GDP with real GDP.

question_en: Business starts with production and ends with ______.
explanation_en: Production is the quantity of goods and services produced in an economy over a given period; in simple terms it is the making of a good or service by industries. Consumption is the use of a good or service. Business starts with production and ends with consumption.

question_en: In which language was Mirat-ul-Akhbar started by Raja Ram Mohan Roy?
explanation_en: Mirat-ul-Akhbar was edited by Raja Ram Mohan Roy in the Persian language. It was first published on 12 April 1822. Samvad Kaumudi, published in Bengali, was another weekly newspaper of his. He also founded the Atmiya Sabha (1815) and the Brahmo Samaj (1828).

question_en: Which of the following is not a Maharatna company?
explanation_en: Maharatna status is given to a company that has earned a net profit of more than Rs. 5,000 crore for three consecutive years, or an average annual turnover of Rs. 25,000 crore, or an average annual net worth of Rs. 15,000 crore. The Maharatna scheme began in 2010 to help large public-sector enterprises become global giants. India currently has 14 Maharatna companies; HAL was the 14th, but at the time this question was set it was not yet included.

question_en: Which is the largest item of expenditure (in percentage) in the Union Budget 2020-21?
option_b_en: States' share in taxes and duties
explanation_en: In the Union Budget 2020-21 the largest item of expenditure (in percentage) was the states' share in taxes and duties. For reference, in the 2025-26 budget total receipts and total expenditure were estimated at Rs. 34.96 lakh crore and Rs. 50.65 lakh crore respectively, with the largest income item being borrowing and other liabilities (24%) and the largest expenditure item being states' share in taxes and duties (22%).

question_en: In which of the following year, Bismarck became the chancellor of Germany?
explanation_en: On 21 March 1871 Otto von Bismarck became chancellor of Germany. Through his diplomatic skill and his policy of 'blood and iron', he completed the unification of Germany.

question_en: Philosophers like Rousseau, Voltaire and Montesquieu were associated with which of the following revolutions?
explanation_en: The French Revolution began on 14 July 1789 with the storming of the Bastille prison in Paris. Its aim was to remove the king from the throne and establish a republic. Philosophers like Rousseau, Voltaire and Montesquieu played an important role in this revolution.

question_en: Which method of farming is generally adopted in India?
explanation_en: Mixed farming is generally adopted in India. In mixed farming, alongside crop production, animal husbandry and dairy industry are also carried out. Besides India, it is practised in countries such as Malaysia, Indonesia, Afghanistan, South Africa and Canada.

question_en: In which district of Madhya Pradesh is the Fair of Nagaji held?
explanation_en: The Nagaji fair, held in November-December, takes place in Porsa village of Morena district in Madhya Pradesh. It is organised in memory of Sant Nagaji, a contemporary of Emperor Akbar. The fair is linked to the tribal community of Madhya Pradesh and lasts about a month.

question_en: In which of the following places is the Fair of Mahamrityunjaya held in Madhya Pradesh?
explanation_en: The Mahamrityunjaya fair is held in Rewa district of Madhya Pradesh on the occasions of Basant Panchami and Shivaratri. The Mahamrityunjaya temple is located in Rewa. There is also a Heera-bhoomi fair held near Gwalior and Guna in memory of 'Heeraman Baba'.

question_en: Who out of the following was the founder of the Maihar Gharana?
explanation_en: The founder of the Maihar Gharana was Ustad Allauddin Khan. The Maihar Gharana is a famous gharana of Indian classical music, and Ustad Allauddin Khan is regarded as its patriarch. He composed many ragas and founded the Maihar College of Music. For his contribution he was honoured by the Government of India with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship, Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan.

question_en: S. H. Raza was an eminent ______.
explanation_en: Sayed Haider Raza (S. H. Raza) was born on 22 February 1922 in Kakkaiya (Mandla), Madhya Pradesh. He was an Indian painter who spent much of his life in France. Influenced by his contribution to Indian art, the Government of India honoured him with awards such as the Padma Vibhushan (2013), Padma Bhushan (2007), Padma Shri (1981) and the Lalit Kala Akademi Fellowship (1983).

question_en: The Imaliya Gold Block is in the district of ______.
explanation_en: The Imaliya Gold Block is located in Katni district of Madhya Pradesh, where high-quality gold ore is found. The gold ore in Imaliya was discovered by the Geological Survey of India.

question_en: Which film has been selected as Official Entry from India for Oscar Awards- 2022?
explanation_en: The film Koozhangal was officially selected as India's entry for the Oscar Awards 2022. For the 96th Academy Awards in 2024, India nominated the Malayalam film '2018: Everyone is a Hero'.

question_en: Who become the first Indian and Asian women to receive the wild innovator Award 2021?
explanation_en: Krithi K. Karanth became the first Indian and Asian woman to receive the Wild Innovator Award 2021. She is a conservation biologist and the chief conservation scientist at the Bengaluru-based Centre for Wildlife Studies (CWS). She has worked on issues such as human-wildlife conflict and land-use change.

question_en: The toxicity in the environment will harm a person's ______ to a high level.
explanation_en: Toxicity in the environment causes diseases such as respiratory illness, skin disease and cancer to spread rapidly in humans. Noise, air and water pollution damage our overall health. There is a proportional relationship between environmental impurity and human health; the main causes of environmental pollution are increasing air, water and noise pollution.

question_en: Which of the following constellation is also known as 'Big Dipper'?
explanation_en: Ursa Major (Saptarishi constellation) is visible in the northern hemisphere of the Earth. It contains seven stars, named after seven ancient sages. Many galaxies are also found in it. The constellation is known by different names in different cultures and civilisations, and is also called the 'Big Dipper'.

question_en: Work cannot be done without what?
explanation_en: Displacement is the change in the position of an object. Without displacement the result of work is zero. Displacement is a vector quantity, meaning it has both magnitude and direction. Its SI unit is the metre.

question_en: An implement used for weeding is ______.
explanation_en: The implement used for weeding is the hoe (khurpi). A funnel is a tube or cone-shaped device used to pour liquid or powder into a small opening. A hoe is used for removing weeds and loosening the soil.

question_en: Assertion (A): A disaster is a sudden disruption of the natural balance causing harm to individual life and property. Reason (R): Disaster management is the strategy to save life at the time or before the occurrence of such hazards.
option_a_en: Both A and R are true
option_b_en: Both A and R are false
option_c_en: A is true, but R is false
option_d_en: A is false, but R is true
explanation_en: According to the Disaster Management Act, 2005, a disaster means an accident, calamity or grave injury in an area from natural or man-made causes, resulting in loss of life, property or environment. The Ministry of Home Affairs is the nodal ministry for the National Disaster Management. A systematic structure of institutions is established for disaster management at the national, state and district levels.

question_en: Assertion (A): The number of consumers in the environment goes on increasing gradually. Reason (R): Gradual increase in consumers would lead to food scarcity and as a result the living beings would die.
option_a_en: Both A and R are true
option_b_en: Both A and R are false
option_c_en: A is true but R is false
option_d_en: A is false but R is true
explanation_en: As the number of consumers in the environment increases, food gradually becomes scarce among them. As a result, the threat to the survival of organisms arises and they begin to die from lack of food. In a food chain the number of producers is greatest because primary consumers depend on producers, and secondary and tertiary (top) consumers depend on them in turn.

question_en: What is the main use of salt in the diet?
option_b_en: produce in small amounts the hydrochloric acid required for the digestion of food
explanation_en: The main use of salt in the diet is to regulate the amount of hydrochloric acid required for digestion. The iodine present in salt helps in the production of thyroid hormone. Salt helps cells absorb nutrients, stops the spread of bacteria, and the sodium in it helps maintain the balance of water and minerals in the body.

question_en: Which of the following is present in the thermometer?
explanation_en: A thermometer is a device used to measure temperature. Mercury expands when heated and contracts when cooled; by observing this change the temperature is estimated. Mercury is a good conductor of heat. Its freezing point is -38 degrees C and its boiling point is 356 degrees C.

question_en: Sweet Revolution of India is launched to increase the production of ______.
explanation_en: India's Sweet Revolution was launched to increase the production of honey. For reference, other revolutions and their associations are: Green Revolution - foodgrains; Yellow Revolution - oilseed production; Pink Revolution - onion/prawn production; Blue Revolution - fish production; Sweet Revolution - honey production.

question_en: One gram fat on oxidation gives about ______ of energy.
explanation_en: On oxidation, one gram of fat provides about 9 kilocalories or 37.8 joules of energy. Fat provides more energy than protein and carbohydrate. One gram of carbohydrate provides 4 calories and one gram of protein provides 4 kilocalories. The unit of energy is the calorie, and one calorie equals 4.2 joules.

question_en: Which of the following is the fastest growing plant in the world?
explanation_en: Bamboo is a grass and an angiosperm, a monocotyledonous woody plant. It is the fastest-growing woody plant on Earth. It has economic and cultural importance and is used for house building and as a food source. Bamboo is an important plant of western and south-western Asia.

question_en: LPG contains a mixture of ______.
explanation_en: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) contains propane, butane and isobutane as its main components. Natural gases contain methane and ethane as their main components. The odour that warns of an LPG leak comes from the chemical ethyl mercaptan added to it.

question_en: What called prothallus?
explanation_en: The prothallus is the gametophyte found in the life cycle of a fern or pteridophyte. It is a green, heart- or kidney-shaped photosynthetic structure. It has no roots, stem or leaves. The male and female reproductive organs of the prothallus are called antheridia and archegonia respectively. The prothallus has rhizoids that attach it to the soil and help in absorption.

question_en: Which one the following is an egg-laying mammal?
explanation_en: An egg-laying mammal is called a monotreme. Egg-laying mammals include the platypus and the echidna. They are warm-blooded animals found in Australia and Papua New Guinea. They have a single opening called the cloaca for reproduction and excretion.

question_en: Phylum porifera is classified on the basis of ______.
explanation_en: Porifera are classified on the basis of the spicules present in their body. The phylum is divided into three classes: Calcarea, Hexactinellida and Demospongiae. Demospongiae is the largest class of sponges and contains protein spicules; Calcarea has hard spicules made of calcium carbonate; and Hexactinellida animals are known as glass sponges.

question_en: Find the number of triangles in the given figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुजों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: The worked solution counts triangles made of a single component (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 = 5) plus triangles made of two components ((1,2), (2,3), (3,4), (4,1) = 4), giving a total of 5 + 4 = 9. The Commission, however, treated option (c) 7 as the correct answer.
note: Answer disputed: Worked solution counts 9 triangles (5 single + 4 double), but the Commission's official key marks option (c) 7 as the answer.

question_en: Find the number of triangles in the given figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुजों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: The worked solution counts triangles made of a single component (1 through 10 = 10), triangles made of two components ((2,3), (6,5), (7,8), (9,10), (2,9), (3,10), (7,6), (8,5) = 8) and triangles made of three components ((2,3,4), (1,2,3), (1,6,5), (4,5,6) = 4), giving a total of 10 + 8 + 4 = 22. None of the options matches; the Commission treated option (d) 14 as the correct answer.
note: Answer disputed: Worked solution counts 22 triangles (10 single + 8 double + 4 triple), which matches no listed option; the Commission treated option (d) 14 as the answer.

question_en: Select the letter-cluster that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster. Kcac : Cack :: XgmF : ?
explanation_en: Just as the letters of Kcac are reversed to give Cack, reversing the letters of XgmF gives FmgX. Therefore the answer is FmgX.

question_en: Choose the numbers which is different from others in the group.
explanation_en: Checking the given options: (8, 6, 24): 8 = 2x2x2, 6 = 2x3, so 2x2x2x3 = 24. (12, 3, 12): 12 = 2x2x3, 3 = 1x3, so 2x2x3 = 12. (8, 2, 2): 8 = 2x2x2, 2 = 1x2, so 2x2x2 = 8, which does not equal 2 (inconsistent). (18, 24, 72): 18 = 2x3x3, 24 = 2x2x2x3, so 2x2x2x3x3 = 72. Hence option (c) does not follow the pattern.

question_en: In the given figure, Circle represents the Women, Triangle represents the persons who work in a showroom and square represents the persons who work in a School. Find out the number of Women who are unemployed.
question_hi: दी गई आकृति में, वृत्त महिलाओं का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, त्रिभुज शोरूम में काम करने वाले व्यक्तियों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है और वर्ग एक स्कूल में काम करने वाले व्यक्तियों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। बेरोजगार महिलाओं की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: In the figure, the region belonging only to the circle (women) and not overlapping with the triangle (showroom workers) or the square (school workers) represents unemployed women. That region contains the value 9, so the number of unemployed women is 9.

question_en: Find the missing term in the following series. MNPQ, RISL, WDVG, BYYB, ?
explanation_en: The series follows a pattern where the letters change position by position: the first letters advance by +5 (M -> R -> W -> B -> G), the second letters change by -5 (N -> I -> D -> Y -> T), the third letters advance by +3 (P -> S -> V -> Y -> B), and the fourth letters change by -5 (Q -> L -> G -> B -> W). This gives GTBW.

question_en: What should come in place of question mark (?) in the following question? ABC : ? :: PQR : QSU
explanation_en: Just as in PQR : QSU the letters advance by +1, +2, +3 (P+1=Q, Q+2=S, R+3=U), applying the same to ABC gives A+1=B, B+2=D, C+3=F, i.e. BDF.

question_en: Abhay walked 20 m towards north, took a right turn and walked 10 m. He again took right turn and walked 20 m. How far and in which direction is he from the starting point?
explanation_en: Abhay walks 20 m north, then turns right (east) and walks 10 m, then turns right again (south) and walks 20 m back down. He ends up 10 m to the east of his starting point. Therefore he is 10 m east of the starting point.

question_en: Which is the wrong term in the following series? 4, 7, 12, 19, 28, 40
explanation_en: The series increases by successive odd numbers: 4 (+3) 7 (+5) 12 (+7) 19 (+9) 28 (+11) should give 39, not 40. Hence the wrong term is 40.

question_en: In the following question, a certain series of numbers or letters is given of which one series is empty. You have to decide which of the alternative series will be used in the blank space that is originally related to the sequence of that series. GL6, IJ9, KH12, MF15, ?
explanation_en: The series follows: the first letters advance by +2 (G -> I -> K -> M -> O), the second letters change by -2 (L -> J -> H -> F -> D), and the numbers advance by +3 (6 -> 9 -> 12 -> 15 -> 18). This gives OD18.

question_en: A figure analogy is given below. Understand the logic behind it and complete the analogy for the next figure.
question_hi: एक आकृति सादृश्य नीचे दिया गया है। इसके पीछे के तर्क को समझें और अगली आकृति के लिए सादृश्य को पूर्ण करें।
explanation_en: Just as the first figure is rotated to obtain the second figure, applying the same rotation to the third figure gives the figure in option (d).

question_en: Select the option that will come next in the given series.
question_hi: उस विकल्प का चयन करें जो दी गई श्रृंखला में आगे आएगा।
explanation_en: In the given series each figure is rotated 90 degrees anticlockwise from the previous one. Continuing the 90-degree anticlockwise rotation, the figure in option (d) completes the blank space.

question_en: Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number. 8 : 512 :: ? : 4913
explanation_en: Just as 8 cubed = 512, the number whose cube is 4913 is 17 (17 cubed = 4913). Therefore the answer is 17.

question_en: Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number. 25 : 40 :: 36 : ?
explanation_en: The relationship is x2 - 10: 25 x 2 - 10 = 40, so 36 x 2 - 10 = 62. Therefore the answer is 62.

question_en: Identify the class that best represents the Venn-diagram (three nested circles).
question_hi: उस वर्ग की पहचान करें जो वेन-आरेख का सबसे अच्छा प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।
explanation_en: In a Venn diagram of three nested circles, each class is fully contained in the larger one. A goalkeeper is a type of footballer, and a footballer is a type of sportsperson, so 'Sportsperson, Footballer, Goalkeeper' best represents the nested relationship.

question_en: How many squares are there in the following figures?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृतियों में कितने वर्ग हैं?
explanation_en: Counting squares in the figure: single-component squares (3, 4) = 2, two-component squares ((1,3), (2,4)) = 2, three-component square (3,4,5) = 1, and the complete outer square = 1. The total number of squares is 6.

question_en: How many triangles are there in the following figures?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृतियों में कितने त्रिभुज हैं?
explanation_en: Counting triangles in the figure: single-component triangles (1 through 7 = 7), two-component triangles ((1,2), (3,5), (4,6) = 3), three-component triangles ((4,6,7), (3,5,7) = 2), and four-component triangles ((2,1,3,5), (1,2,4,6) = 2). The total is 7 + 3 + 2 + 2 = 14.

question_en: If the mirror is placed on the line, then which of the answer figure is the right mirror image of the given figure?
question_hi: यदि एक दर्पण को दर्शाई गई रेखा पर रखा जाये, तो दी गई विकल्प आकृतियों में से कौन-सी सही दर्पण छवि होगी?
explanation_en: The mirror image of the given figure, when the mirror is placed on the indicated line, is the figure shown in option (a).

question_en: Find the odd word/letters/number from the given alternatives.
explanation_en: In each pair the logic is +16: 5 + 16 = 21, 29 + 16 = 45, 71 + 16 = 87. But 48 + 20 = 68 (inconsistent). Hence option (c) is the odd one out.

question_en: Consider the given statement to be true and decide which of the given conclusions/assumptions can definitely be drawn from the given statement. Statement: To achieve economic development, people should work hard. Conclusions: I. Economic development is directly related to people's hard work. II. working hard by all the people is impossible.
explanation_en: Conclusion II, that hard work by all people is impossible, does not follow because it is not stated in the statement. Conclusion I, that economic development is directly related to people's hard work, does follow from the statement. Hence only conclusion I follows.

question_en: Find the value of 2% of 25% of 20000.
What percent decrease in salaries would exactly cancel out the 20 percent increase?
explanation_en: Let the initial salary be 100. After a 20% increase the final salary = 100 + (100 x 20%) = 120. The required percentage decrease = ((120 - 100)/120) x 100 = (1/6) x 100 = 16 + 2/3 %.

question_en: If the selling price of an article is Rs.700 and Cost price is Rs.680. Find the percentage of loss or profit?
explanation_en: Cost price = 680, Selling price = 700. Profit = 700 - 680 = 20. Profit % = (profit/cost price) x 100 = (20/680) x 100 = 100/34 = 2.94%.

question_en: If the 70% of cost price is equal to the 40% of selling price, then what would be the percentage of loss or profit?
explanation_en: Given CP x 70% = SP x 40%, so CP/SP = 4/7, meaning CP = 4 and SP = 7. Profit = SP - CP = 7 - 4 = 3. Profit % = (profit/cost price) x 100 = (3/4) x 100 = 75% profit.

question_en: By selling a car for Rs.64774 Ravneet gains 16.5%. For how much should he sell the car to gain 35%?
explanation_en: Selling price of the car = 64774. Cost price = 64774 x (100/116.5) = 55600. To gain 35%, selling price = 55600 x (135/100) = 75060.

question_en: Sita earns Rs. 44100 per month. She spends 20/21 of her income and deposits rest of the money in a bank. How much money does she deposit in the bank each month?
explanation_en: Sita's income = 44100. Her expenditure = 44100 x (20/21) = 42000. Savings = income - expenditure = 44100 - 42000 = 2100. Therefore she deposits Rs. 2100 in the bank each month.

question_en: If Vikram has 150 cars and out of them 48% cars are fine, then what will be the number of defective cars?
explanation_en: Vikram has 150 cars, of which 48% are fine. Number of defective cars = 150 x ((100 - 48)/100) = 150 x (52/100) = 78.

question_en: Rahul sold a bat at Rs 768 and made a profit of 28%. Find the cost price in rupees of the bat.
explanation_en: Selling price of the bat = 768. Cost price = 768 x (100/(100 + 28)) = 768 x (100/128) = 600 rupees.

question_en: The ratio of income of Anand and Amit is 5 : 6. If Anand gets Rs 1100 less than Amit, the total income is:
explanation_en: The ratio of income of Anand and Amit is 5 : 6, a difference of 1 part. This 1 part corresponds to Rs 1100. Total income = 5 + 6 = 11 parts = 11 x 1100 = Rs 12100.

question_en: In a class of 217 students, number of boys is 33.33% more than girls. If nine girls are admitted to the class and five boys are rusticated from the class, find the ratio of the number of boys to that of the girls.
explanation_en: Total students = 217. Since 33.33% = 1/3, boys : girls = 4x : 3x, so 7x = 217, giving x = 31. After the change, boys/girls = (4x - 5)/(3x + 9) = (4x31 - 5)/(3x31 + 9) = 119/102 = 7 : 6.

question_en: A sum of Rs. 7000 is deposited at compound interest becomes triple after 4 years. How much will it be after 12 years?
explanation_en: Principal (P) = 7000, time = 4 years, amount = 21000 (triple). Since the amount triples every 4 years, after 12 years (three periods of 4 years) the amount = 7000 x 3^3 = 27 x 7000 = 189000 rupees.

question_en: Find the compound interest on Rs. 300000 at the rate of 20% per annum for 2 years.

If 6% of glass vessel are broken of a glass utensils vendor. And he sells 92% of those remaining utensils, still he does not able to sell 376 glass utensils. So how many utensils did he have with him to begin with?
explanation_en: Let the vendor start with x vessels. After 6% break and 92% of the rest are sold, the unsold amount is x x ((100-6)/100) x ((100-92)/100) = 376. Solving, x = (376 x 100 x 100)/(94 x 8) = 5000. So he had 5000 vessels to begin with.

question_en: A working partner gets 20% as his commission of the profit after his commission is paid. If the working partner commission is Rs. 16000, then what is the total profit in the business?
explanation_en: Let the total profit be x. The commission is 20% of the profit remaining after commission, i.e. (20/100) x (x - 16000) = 16000. So (1/5)(x - 16000) = 16000, giving x - 16000 = 80000, hence x = 96000 rupees.

question_en: A man makes his onward journey at 16 km/hr and backward journey at 28 km/hr. What is his average speed during the entire journey (correct to 2 decimal places)?
explanation_en: For equal distances the average speed = (2 x S1 x S2)/(S1 + S2) = (2 x 16 x 28)/(16 + 28) = 896/44 = 20.36 km/hr.

question_en: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 35 + 8 x 4 - 18 / 9 = 5
explanation_en: Interchanging the + and - signs gives 35 - 8 x 4 + 18 / 9 = 5, which becomes 35 - 32 + 2 = 5, i.e. 37 - 32 = 5, so 5 = 5. Left side equals right side, so interchanging + and - is correct.

question_en: Which of the following cube in the answer figure cannot be made based on the unfolded cube in the question figure?
question_hi: उत्तर आकृति में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा घन प्रश्न आकृति में खुले घन के आधार पर नहीं बनाया जा सकता है?
explanation_en: Based on the given unfolded cube, the cube shown in option (d) cannot be formed.

question_en: If 'M' denotes '+', 'N' denotes '/', 'R' denotes '-' and 'Q' denotes 'x' then, 15 M 12 Q 5 R 40 N 8 = ?
explanation_en: Substituting the signs (M=+, N=/, R=-, Q=x): 15 + 12 x 5 - 40 / 8 = ? This becomes 15 + 60 - 5 = 75 - 5 = 70.

question_en: If time in a clock is 9 : 11, then at what time will appear in water?
explanation_en: The clock shows the actual time 9 : 11. The water (mirror) reflection of the time is found by subtracting from 18:30: 18 : 30 - 9 : 11 = 9 : 19.

question_en: What is the angle between minute and hour hand at 3 : 56?
explanation_en: Using the formula M = (2/11)[H x 30 +/- theta]: 56 = (2/11)[3 x 30 +/- theta], so 616 = 180 +/- 2 theta, giving 2 theta = 616 - 180 = 436, hence theta = 218 degrees. The larger angle between the minute and hour hands is 218 degrees.

question_en: The bus for Chennai leaves every 30 minutes from a bus depot. The enquiry clerk told a passenger that the bus for Chennai left 10 minutes ago, and the next bus will leave at 10:30 a.m. What was the time when enquiry clerk told this?
explanation_en: The bus that left for Chennai departed at 10:30 - 30 minutes = 10:00. The clerk told the passenger this 10 minutes after that bus left, i.e. 10:00 + 10 minutes = 10:10 a.m.

question_en: A clock buzzes 1 time at 1 O'clock, 2 time at 2 O'clock, 3 time at 3 O'clock and so on. What will be the total number of buzzes in a day?
explanation_en: The clock buzzes in the pattern 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + ... + 12. In 12 hours it buzzes n(n+1)/2 = 12(12+1)/2 = 78 times. In 24 hours (a full day) it buzzes 78 x 2 = 156 times.

question_en: In the following equation, select correct combination of mathematical signs to replace A and balance the equation. 57 A 63 A 299 A 23 A 107
explanation_en: Placing the signs (+, -, /, =) for A: 57 + 63 - 299 / 23 = 107, which becomes 57 + 63 - 13 = 107, i.e. 120 - 13 = 107, so 107 = 107. Left side equals right side, so the equation is balanced.

question_en: Find the next term in the series. AZ, BY, ?, DV, ET
explanation_en: The first letters advance by +1 (A -> B -> C -> D -> E) and the second letters change by -2 (Z -> Y -> W -> V -> T)... following the pattern the missing term is CW.

question_en: Arrange the following words as per order in the dictionary. 1. Billion 2. Bifurcate 3. Bilateral 4. Bilirubin
explanation_en: In dictionary order the meaningful sequence is: (2) Bifurcate, (3) Bilateral, (4) Bilirubin, (1) Billion. Hence the logical order is 2, 3, 4, 1.

question_en: From the given alternative words, select the word which cannot be formed using the letters of the given word. ACTUATOR
explanation_en: The word 'Actuate' cannot be formed using the letters of ACTUATOR because the original word does not contain the letter 'e'.

question_en: If HECK is coded as 94410 and DIG is coded as 588, then how will BIKE coded as?
explanation_en: In HECK = 94410, the letter positions are H=8, E=5, C=3, K=11, and adding +1, +1, +1, -1 gives 9, 4, 4, 10. In DIG = 588, D=4, I=9, G=7 with +1, +1, +1 gives 5, 8, 8. Applying the same to BIKE: B=2, I=9, K=11, E=5 with +1, +1, +1, -1 gives 3, 8, 12, 4, i.e. 38124.

question_en: If 'THEN' is written as 'RLBS', then how may 'CASE' be written in that code?
explanation_en: In THEN -> RLBS the letters change by -2, +4, -3, +5 (T-2=R, H+4=L, E-3=B, N+5=S). Applying the same shifts to CASE: C-2=A, A+4=E, S-3=P, E+5=J, giving AEPJ.

question_en: In a code language, PENCIL is written as PNEICL. How will MOTHER be written as in that language?
explanation_en: In PENCIL -> PNEICL, the letters are swapped in pairs after the first: positions 2 and 3 swap, positions 4 and 5 swap, keeping 1 and 6 fixed (P-EN-CI-L becomes P-NE-IC-L). Applying the same pattern to MOTHER (M-OT-HE-R) gives M-TO-EH-R, i.e. MTOEHR.

question_en: In a certain code, 'POWER' is coded as '#*5@7' and 'BREAKS' is coded as '$7@%03'. How is 'PAPERS' coded in that coded?
explanation_en: From POWER = #*5@7, we get P=#, O=*, W=5, E=@, R=7. From BREAKS = $7@%03, we get B=$, R=7, E=@, A=%, K=0, S=3. Coding PAPERS: P=#, A=%, P=#, E=@, R=7, S=3, giving #%#@73.

question_en: The product of two numbers is 5043. If the HCF of these numbers is 41 then what is the greater number?
explanation_en: Let the first number = 41x and the second = 41y. Then 41x x 41y = 5043, so x x y = 5043/(41 x 41) = 3 = 1 x 3. The greater number = 41y = 41 x 3 = 123.

question_en: If triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, such that angle A = 47 degrees and angle E = 63 degrees, then angle C is equal to:
explanation_en: Since triangle ABC ~ triangle DEF, angle A = 47 degrees and angle E = angle B = 63 degrees (corresponding angles of similar triangles). The sum of all angles of triangle ABC is 180 degrees, so angle C = 180 - (47 + 63) = 180 - 110 = 70 degrees.

question_en: If (9^n x 3^5 x (27)^3) / (3 x 81^4) = 27, then the value of n is:
If x^(1/p) = y^(1/q) = z^(1/r) and xyz = 1, then the value of p + q + r would be:
explanation_en: Let x^(1/p) = y^(1/q) = z^(1/r) = k. Then x = k^p, y = k^q, z = k^r. Since xyz = 1, k^(p+q+r) = k^0 (because anything to the power 0 equals 1). Therefore p + q + r = 0.

question_en: If a + b + 1 = 0 then what is the value of (a^3 + b^3 + 1 - 3ab)?
explanation_en: Given a + b + 1 = 0, so a + b = -1. Cubing both sides: (a + b)^3 = (-1)^3, which gives a^3 + b^3 + 3ab(a + b) = -1, so a^3 + b^3 - 3ab = -1, hence a^3 + b^3 - 3ab + 1 = 0.

question_en: In what time will a train, 60 metres long, running at the speed of 36 km/hr pass a telegraph post?
explanation_en: Using speed = distance/time, and converting 36 km/hr to m/s (36 x 5/18 = 10 m/s), time = 60/10 = 6 seconds.

question_en: The area of the trapezium is 1152 cm^2 and shortest distance is 16 cm, if the ratio of its parallel sides is 4 : 5, then find the length of longer side.
explanation_en: Area of trapezium = (1/2)(sum of parallel sides) x height. So 1152 = (1/2)(4x + 5x) x 16, giving 144 = 9x, so x = 16. The longer side = 5x = 5 x 16 = 80 cm.

question_en: What value would come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation? 42 x 21 / 6 + 623 + sqrt(2704) = ?
What is the least number that when divided by 60, 84, and 96 leaves the remainders 28, 52, and 64 respectively?
explanation_en: The difference between each divisor and its remainder is constant: (60 - 28) = (84 - 52) = (96 - 64) = 32. The required number = LCM(60, 84, 96) - 32 = 3360 - 32 = 3328.

question_en: What will be HCF of 54/9, 60/17 and 36/51?
explanation_en: The given fractions are 54/9, 60/17, 36/51, which simplify to 6/1, 60/17, 12/17. HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators / LCM of denominators = HCF(6, 60, 12) / LCM(1, 17, 17) = 6/17.

question_en: On the map, a length of 3/4 cm represents the distance of 240 km on the ground. What length on the map will represents the distance of two cites. Which are 1820 km a part on the ground?
explanation_en: If 3/4 cm represents 240 km, then 1 km is represented by 3/(4 x 240) cm. So 1820 km is represented by (3/(4 x 240)) x 1820 = 91/16 = 5.68 cm.

question_en: Ramakant is running around a rectangular track of length 180 m and breadth 90 m with a speed of 10.8 km/h. How much time in minutes will he take to complete 10 rounds?
explanation_en: Total distance for 10 rounds = 2(length + breadth) x 10 = 2(180 + 90) x 10 = 20 x 270 = 5400 m. Time = 5400 / (10.8 x 5/18) = 5400/3 = 1800 seconds = 30 minutes.

question_en: Which of these numbers cannot be a probability?
explanation_en: The probability of an event always lies between 0 and 1, so it can never be negative or greater than 1 (0 <= P(E) <= 1). Checking the options: 30% = 0.3 (valid), 0.005 (valid), 0 (valid), -0.6 (invalid). Hence -0.6 cannot be a probability.

question_en: A student answered 108 questions in an examination. In this examination, every wrong answer was given 1/3 minus mark and the right answer was given 1 mark. If the student scored zero marks, how many wrong questions were done by him?
explanation_en: Let correct answers = x and wrong answers = y. Then x + y = 108. Since the score is zero, -y x (1/3) + x = 0, giving y = 3x. Substituting, x + 3x = 108, so 4x = 108, x = 27. Wrong answers = y = 108 - 27 = 81.

question_en: One-third of a number is 96. What will 40% of that number be?
explanation_en: Let the number be x. Then x x (1/3) = 96 x 40%... solving, x = 288, and 40% of 288 = 288 x (40/100) = 115.2.

question_en: Peaty Soils are found in which type of areas?
explanation_en: Peaty (organic) soil forms in areas of heavy rainfall and high humidity that support dense vegetation. It is black, heavy and acidic; in India it occurs in northern Bihar, southern Uttarakhand, coastal West Bengal, Odisha and Tamil Nadu.

question_en: How much amount is given as a monetary award in the Indira Gandhi Peace Prize?
explanation_en: The Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development, awarded annually since 1986 by the Indira Gandhi Memorial Trust, carries a citation and Rs. 25 lakh.

question_en: Booker Prize was first awarded in which of the following years?
explanation_en: The Booker Prize for fiction was first awarded in 1969, to P. H. Newby for 'Something to Answer For'. It honours the best original English-language novel each year.

question_en: Identify the odd one out of the following:
explanation_en: Brihadeshwar, Sri Ranganatha Swami and Meenakshi Amman temples are in Tamil Nadu, whereas Hampi is in Vijayanagara district of Karnataka on the Tungabhadra river.

question_en: Sixty percent of the world's people stay in just how many countries?
explanation_en: About 60% of the world's population lives in just 10 countries: China, India, USA, Indonesia, Brazil, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Russia and Japan.

question_en: Who was the chairman of the first comprehensive attempt at reforming the tax system by the Taxation Enquiry Commission (TEC) 1953-54?
explanation_en: The Taxation Enquiry Commission of 1953-54, the first comprehensive tax reform effort, was chaired by economist and educationist John Matthai, who received the Padma Vibhushan in 1959.

question_en: Ports those are located away from the sea coast are known as?
explanation_en: Ports located away from the coast are inland (or dry) ports, linked to the sea by rivers or canals and used for inland transport of sea cargo. Kolkata and Manchester are examples.

question_en: Who among the following leaders is associated with Khudai Khidmatgar movement?
explanation_en: Khan Abdul Gaffar Khan (Frontier Gandhi, Bacha Khan) founded the Khudai Khidmatgar ('Servants of God') movement in 1929, a non-violent movement against British rule inspired by Gandhi.

question_en: What is the position of India in terms of pharmaceutical production?
explanation_en: India ranks third globally in pharmaceutical production by volume and is the largest supplier of generic medicines, accounting for about 20% of global generic exports.

question_en: According to the Union Budget 2020-21, what is the highest rate of direct tax in India?
explanation_en: Under the Union Budget 2020-21, individuals with taxable income above Rs. 15 lakh pay 30% tax. (Budget 2023-24 later cut the top surcharge under the new regime from 37% to 25%, lowering the maximum rate from 42.74% to 39%.)

question_en: Who is the father of scientific socialism?
explanation_en: Karl Marx (Karl Heinrich Marx, born 5 May 1818 in Trier, Germany), philosopher, economist and sociologist, is regarded as the father of scientific socialism; he held that society is divided into two classes, the capitalists and the proletariat.

question_en: Who among the following was known by the name of Little Corporal?
explanation_en: Napoleon Bonaparte, the French military leader and emperor born in Ajaccio, Corsica in 1769, was affectionately nicknamed 'The Little Corporal' during his military career.

question_en: In which areas "Slash and burn cultivation" is done in India?
explanation_en: Slash-and-burn (jhum) cultivation, where forest is cut and burned before sowing, is mainly practised in North-East India: Assam, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh and Tripura.

question_en: Ahirai is the traditional dance of which of the following tribes of Madhya Pradesh?
explanation_en: Ahirai is the traditional dance of the Bharia tribe of Madhya Pradesh, performed at weddings. Other Bharia dances include Bharam, Setam and Saila.

question_en: The chikara is a ______. (From the given options only)
explanation_en: The chikara is a bowed string instrument used in Indian folk music, especially by tribal communities of Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh.

question_en: In which year did Daulat Rao Sindhia establish Gwalior as capital?
explanation_en: Daulat Rao Scindia made Gwalior his capital in 1810. He ruled the Maratha state of Gwalior from 1794 until his death in 1827 and fought in the Second and Third Anglo-Maratha Wars.

question_en: Which of the following places of MP was once ruled by Shah-Jahan for a very long period?
explanation_en: Shah Jahan governed from Burhanpur, called the 'Gateway of South India', for a long time and built several structures there, including the Gulara Mahal for his consort Gulara.

question_en: Which of the following districts of Madhya Pradesh is known for diamond?
explanation_en: Panna district, amid the Vindhya ranges, is famous for diamonds and has Asia's largest and only active diamond mine; it is called 'The City of Diamonds'.

question_en: Which of the following Chief Minister has been Honoured with the Skoch Chief Minister of the Year Award?
explanation_en: Andhra Pradesh CM Y. S. Jagan Mohan Reddy received the Skoch Chief Minister of the Year award in February 2021, presented by Skoch Group chairman Sameer Kochhar.

question_en: Who has become the first woman to win 28 Grammy Award?
explanation_en: At the 2021 Grammys Beyonce won four awards, becoming the first woman to reach 28 Grammys and setting the record for most wins by a female artist at that time.

question_en: What is the group or lump of cancerous cells called?
explanation_en: A lump of cancerous cells is a malignant tumour; it can invade nearby tissue and spread to other parts of the body. Not all lumps are cancerous. Common sites include skin, lungs, breast, prostate, colon and rectum.

question_en: The decrease in the platelet count can lead to internal ______.
explanation_en: A low platelet count impairs clotting and can lead to haemorrhage (bleeding, e.g. nosebleeds). Other causes of nosebleeds include dry air, colds and sinusitis, nose picking, blood-thinning drugs and rhinitis.

question_en: What is the SI unit of work?
explanation_en: The SI unit of work is the joule. For reference: current - ampere, temperature - kelvin, length - metre, mass - kilogram.

question_en: The two types of energy is kinetic and ______.
explanation_en: The two main forms of energy are kinetic (depends on mass and motion, e.g. electrical, sound, radiant, thermal) and potential (stored energy, e.g. chemical, gravitational, elastic, nuclear).

question_en: Match the following: 1. Wildlife sanctuary, 2. World environment day, 3. Wildlife week with A. First week of June, B. First week of October, C. Conservation of wildlife.
explanation_en: Wildlife sanctuary - conservation of wildlife; World Environment Day - first week of June (5 June); Wildlife Week - first week of October.

question_en: Assertion (A): Overcoming pollution is a powerful way of environmental management. Reason (R): Environmental management is required due to various problems that affect natural and artificial factors on the earth.
option_a_en: Both A and R are true
option_b_en: Both A and R are false
option_c_en: A is true, but R is false
option_d_en: A is false, but R is true
explanation_en: Controlling pollution is an important means of environmental management, and management is needed because of the many natural and man-made problems affecting the earth. Both statements are true.

question_en: Which one is wrong about the effect of industry established on the river bank on the river ecosystem?
option_a_en: This would lead to water pollution.
option_b_en: These substances make the water impure to use and unfit for drinking.
option_c_en: It will also lead to the destruction of marine life.
option_d_en: It provides toxic carbon dioxide of marine plant life.
explanation_en: Riverside industry pollutes the water, making it unfit for use and drinking and harming aquatic life. The claim that it provides 'toxic carbon dioxide' to aquatic plants is incorrect.

question_en: Which oil is used in the froth floatation process?
explanation_en: Pine oil is used in froth flotation. Crushed ore, water, pine oil and a collector such as potassium ethyl xanthate are agitated; ore particles wetted by oil rise to the surface as froth.

question_en: Which of the following is also known as rock-crystal?
explanation_en: Quartz, a mineral of silicon and oxygen, is the most common mineral on earth. Pure, transparent, colourless quartz is called rock crystal.

question_en: The Gir National Park is famous for.
explanation_en: Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary in Gujarat is the only natural home of the Asiatic lion; it covers about 1,424 sq km.

question_en: Scientific name of which of the following is Mangifera indica?
explanation_en: Mangifera indica is mango. Orange - Citrus sinensis; wheat - Triticum aestivum; mustard - Brassica juncea.

question_en: The members of chlorophyceae are commonly called ______.
explanation_en: Members of Chlorophyceae are called green algae. Their body may be unicellular or filamentous, and chlorophyll a and b dominate, giving them a green colour.

question_en: Genera like Selaginella and Salvinia which produce how many kinds of spores?
explanation_en: Selaginella and Salvinia are heterosporous pteridophytes producing two kinds of spores: large megaspores and small microspores (most pteridophytes are homosporous).

question_en: Which one of the following is a reptile?
explanation_en: Reptiles are mostly terrestrial vertebrates with dry, scaly skin; living examples include snakes, lizards, crocodiles and turtles. Penguin, crow and owl are birds.

question_en: Agar is obtained from which of the following?
explanation_en: Agar, a hydrophilic colloid used as a gelling agent and stabiliser, is extracted from Gelidium, a red alga (Rhodophyceae).

question_en: Find the number of triangles in the given figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुज की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: Label the regions 1, 2, 3. Single-region triangles: 3; two-region: (1,2) = 1; three-region: (1,2,3) = 1. Total = 5.

question_en: Find the number of triangles in the given figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुज की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: Label the regions 1-5. Single-region triangles: 5; two-region: (1,2), (2,3), (4,5) = 3; three-region: (1,2,3) = 1. The worked solution counts 9 triangles, which is not among the options.
note: Answer marked (*) in source: worked solution counts 9 triangles (not an option); the commission's official key gave option (d) 7.

question_en: Select the letter-cluster that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster. Dda : aDD :: Rrb : ?
explanation_en: The letters are reversed and the case of each is swapped: Dda -> aDD, so Rrb -> bRR.

question_en: Choose the numbers which is different from others in the group?
explanation_en: In each pair the second number is the square of the first (3-9, 7-49, 13-169), but 8 squared is 64, not 65.

question_en: Choose the numbers which is different from others in the group?
explanation_en: Each term is the square of the previous one (3,9,81; 5,25,625; 2,4,16), but 16 squared is 256, not 64.

question_en: In the given diagram, Triangle represents the person who can speak Hindi, Square represents the person who can speak Punjabi and Circle represents the person who can speak English. The person who can speak all the languages is indicated by which number?
question_hi: दिए गए आरेख में, त्रिभुज उस व्यक्ति का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो हिंदी बोल सकते हैं, वर्ग उस व्यक्ति का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो पंजाबी बोल सकते हैं और वृत्त उस व्यक्ति का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो अंग्रेजी बोल सकते हैं। वह व्यक्ति जो सभी भाषाएँ बोल सकता है, को कौन-सी संख्या इंगित करती है?
explanation_en: Number 10 lies in the common region of the triangle, square and circle, so it represents people who speak all three languages.

question_en: Find the missing term in the following series. SKC, VND, YQE, ?
explanation_en: First letters +3: S, V, Y, B; second letters +3: K, N, Q, T; third letters +1: C, D, E, F. Answer: BTF.

question_en: Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term. CFIL : DGJM :: DHLP : ?
explanation_en: Each letter is shifted +1: CFIL -> DGJM, so DHLP -> EIMQ.

question_en: Which is the wrong term in the following series? 28, 65, 127, 217, 344
explanation_en: The terms follow n^3 + 1 for n = 3 to 7: 28, 65, 126, 217, 344. So 127 should be 126.

question_en: In the following question, a certain series of numbers or letters is given of which one series is empty. Choose the alternative that fits the blank according to the sequence. D4W, G9T, J14Q, ?
explanation_en: First letters +3: D, G, J, M; numbers +5: 4, 9, 14, 19; last letters -3: W, T, Q, N. Answer: M19N.

question_en: A figure analogy is given below. Understand the logic behind it and complete the analogy for the next figure.
question_hi: एक आकृति सादृश्य नीचे दिया गया है। इसके पीछे के तर्क को समझें और अगली आकृति के लिए सादृश्य को पूर्ण करें।
explanation_en: Just as the two separate circles in the first figure are brought together to overlap partially in the second, the two shapes of the third figure overlap partially in option (a).

question_en: Select the option that will come next in the given series.
question_hi: उस विकल्प का चयन करें जो दी गई श्रृंखला में आगे आएगा।
explanation_en: The 0 symbol moves 90 degrees anticlockwise each step, while the # symbol moves 90 degrees clockwise, alternating between inside and outside the figure. Option (a) continues the pattern.

question_en: Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number. 7 : 48 :: ? : 168
explanation_en: 48 = 7^2 - 1, and 168 = 13^2 - 1, so the missing number is 13.

question_en: Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number. 25 : 14 :: 31 : ?
Identify the class that best represents the Venn-diagram.
question_hi: उस वर्ग की पहचान करें जो वेन-आरेख का सबसे अच्छा प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।
explanation_en: The diagram shows two separate circles inside a larger one. Infants and trees are distinct classes, both contained within living beings.

question_en: How many straight lines are there in the following figures?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृतियों में कितनी सीधी रेखाएँ हैं?
explanation_en: Counting horizontal, vertical and the diagonal line in the figure gives 11 straight lines.

question_en: How many triangles are there in the following figures?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृतियों में कितने त्रिभुज हैं?
explanation_en: Label the triangles 1-4. Single-region triangles: 4; two-region: (1,3) = 1. Total = 5.

question_en: If the mirror is placed on the line AB, then which of the answer figure is the right mirror image of the given figure?
question_hi: यदि एक दर्पण को दर्शाई गई रेखा पर रखा जाये, तो दी गई विकल्प आकृतियों में से कौन-सी सही दर्पण छवि होगी?
explanation_en: With the mirror on the vertical line AB, the figure is laterally reversed; option (a) is the correct mirror image.

question_en: Select the odd word/letters/number from the given alternatives.
explanation_en: In each pair the second number is the first plus 11 (43-54, 72-83, 18-29), but 52 + 11 = 63, not 61.

question_en: Statement: Songs always have singers to sing them. Conclusions: I. Singers make a song. II. There is no un-sung song.
option_b_en: Both conclusions I and II follow
option_c_en: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
explanation_en: If every song has singers to sing it, then no song is unsung, so II follows. The statement says nothing about singers composing songs, so I does not follow.

question_en: A coolie deposits Rs. 150 per month in his post office Saving Bank account. If this is 15% of his monthly income, find his monthly income (in rupees).
The sum of the number of boys and girls in a school is 150. If the number of boys is x, then the number of girls becomes x% of the total number of students. The number of boys is:
The total cost of an article, including sales tax, is Rs. 840. The sales tax rate is 20%. If the shopkeeper made a 40% profit, find the cost price of the article.
explanation_en: Let CP = 100. After 40% profit SP = 140; with 20% sales tax, 168. So 168 units = Rs. 840, and CP = 840/168 x 100 = Rs. 500.

question_en: A fruit seller sells all his fruits at a loss of 30%. The cost price of all the fruits is Rs. 15200. If the price is further reduced by 10%, then find its selling price.
Find simple interest? Principal = 20000, rate = 5%, time = 4 years
In what time will the simple interest be 2/5 of the principal at 8 percent per annum?
explanation_en: SI/P = 2/5. Time = (SI x 100)/(P x R) = (2 x 100)/(5 x 8) = 5 years.

question_en: What will come in place of question mark (?) in the following question? (64^2 x 17^2) / 289 = ?
explanation_en: 17^2 = 289 cancels, leaving 64^2 = 4096.

question_en: What percent of 8.2 kg is 24 gms?
In a group the ratio of police and lawyers is 2:3. If the total number of people in the group is 90. What is the number of lawyers in the group?
explanation_en: Police : lawyers = 2x : 3x, so 5x = 90 and x = 18. Lawyers = 3 x 18 = 54.

question_en: A bag contains 312 coins of 1 rupee, 50 paisa and 25 paise. The ratio of value of 1 rupee, 50 paisa and 25 paisa coins are 4:2:1. Find the value of 50 paisa coins.
explanation_en: Let values be 4x, 2x and x. Coin counts are 4x, 4x and 4x, so 12x = 312 and x = 26. Value of 50-paise coins = 2x = Rs. 52.

question_en: The simple interest on a sum deposited at 10% p.a. for 4 years is Rs. 20,000. What will be the compound interest on the same principal sum at half of the above rate of interest for 2 years?

Mukul invested equal sums of money at compound interest under two schemes A and B. Under scheme A, the interest rate was 15% per annum and under scheme B, the interest rate was 18% p.a. The compound interest after two years on the sum invested in scheme A was Rs. 2580. How much is the interest earned under scheme B after two years, if the interest is compounded annually in both schemes?
A certain gift box contains 28 Kit-Kat chocolates and 46 5-star chocolates. How many 5-star chocolates were taken out from the box such that 70% of the chocolates in the box would be Kit-Kat?
Vivek pays income tax at the rate of 10%. If his income increased by 10% and his tax rate increased to 15%, his net income would increase by 2800. What is Vivek's income?
explanation_en: Original net income = 0.9x. New net income = x x 1.1 x 0.85 = 187x/200. Difference = 7x/200 = 2800, so x = 80,000.

question_en: Two men P and Q start together from place A at 3 km/h and 3.75 km/h respectively for place B. Q reaches half an hour before P. What is the distance that each one has covered?
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 72 + 8 x 3 / 12 - 5 = 34
explanation_en: Interchanging + and / gives 72 / 8 x 3 + 12 - 5 = 27 + 12 - 5 = 34, which is correct.

question_en: Which of the following cube in the answer figure cannot be made based on the unfolded cube in the question figure?
question_hi: उत्तर आकृति में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा घन प्रश्न आकृति में खुले घन के आधार पर नहीं बनाया जा सकता है?
explanation_en: In the net, opposite faces are Z-Y, X-T and U-V. Opposite faces cannot be seen together, but option (c) shows Z and Y together, so it cannot be formed.

question_en: If 'x' means subtraction, '+' means multiplication and '-' means addition, then find the value of following equation. 12 + (3 x 1) + 4 - 1
explanation_en: After substituting the signs: 12 x (3 - 1) x 4 + 1 = 12 x 2 x 4 + 1 = 97.

question_en: What was the day of week on 19 June 1440?
explanation_en: Odd days: 1200 years = 0, 200 years = 3, 39 years (9 leap + 30 ordinary) = 48 = 6, 1 Jan to 19 Jun = 170 days = 3. Total = 12, i.e. 5 odd days, which corresponds to Friday.

question_en: If day before yesterday was Wednesday, when will Sunday be?
explanation_en: Day before yesterday was Wednesday, so today is Friday; Sunday is the day after tomorrow.

question_en: What is the angle between minute and hour hand at 12:20?
explanation_en: Minute hand moves 20 x 6 = 120 degrees; hour hand moves 20 x 0.5 = 10 degrees. Angle = 120 - 10 = 110 degrees.

question_en: If 50 minutes ago, it was 45 minutes past four O'clock, how many minutes is it until six O'clock?
explanation_en: Current time = 4:45 + 50 min = 5:35, so 25 minutes remain until 6:00.

question_en: In the following equation, select correct combination of mathematical signs to replace A and balance the equation. 60 A 5307 A 174 A 2 A 1
Find the next term in the series. XA, ?, VC, UD, TE
explanation_en: First letters decrease by 1 (X, W, V, U, T) and second letters increase by 1 (A, B, C, D, E). Missing term: WB.

question_en: Arrange the following words as per order in the dictionary. 1. Pick 2. Pith 3. Pile 4. Perk 5. Pour
explanation_en: Dictionary order: Perk, Pick, Pile, Pith, Pour = 4, 1, 3, 2, 5.

question_en: Which one word can be formed from the following letters? b c k a h u s r
explanation_en: Using the letters b, c, k, a, h, u, s, r the word 'backrush' can be formed.

question_en: If CAB = 12 and FED = 30, then HIDE = ______.
explanation_en: Sum of letter positions x 2: CAB = (3+1+2) x 2 = 12; FED = (6+5+4) x 2 = 30; HIDE = (8+9+4+5) x 2 = 52.

question_en: In a certain code CAMEL is written as MFNBD. How shall TIGER be written in that code?
explanation_en: The coding rearranges the letters and shifts some by +1/-1 in a fixed positional pattern; applying the same pattern to TIGER gives SFHJU.

question_en: In a code language EXPLAIN is written as XEALPNI. How will FACTORY be written in that language?
explanation_en: Letters are swapped in groups: EX -> XE, PLA -> ALP, IN -> NI. Similarly FA -> AF, CTO -> OTC, RY -> YR, giving AFOTCYR.

question_en: In a certain code, if ALPHABET is coded as RHZDFSJD and MARKER is coded as PHIUYP, then how is "MATERIAL" coded in that code?
explanation_en: The word is reversed and alternate letters are shifted by -2 and +3. Applying the same rule to MATERIAL gives JDGUCWYP.

question_en: Three numbers are in the ratio of 4 : 7 : 9 and their LCM is 2520. Find their HCF?
explanation_en: Numbers are 4x, 7x, 9x with LCM 252x = 2520, so x = 10. The numbers are 40, 70, 90 and their HCF is 10.

question_en: A merchant has 60 liters of oil of one kind, 90 liters of another kind and 120 liters of third kind. He wants to sell the oil by filling the three kinds of oil in tins of equal capacity. What should be the greatest capacity of such a tin?
explanation_en: Greatest tin capacity = HCF(60, 90, 120) = 2 x 3 x 5 = 30 litres.

question_en: If (9/4)^x . (8/27)^(x-1) = 2/3, then the value of x is:
If a^x = b^y = c^z and b^2 = ac, then y equals
explanation_en: Let a^x = b^y = c^z = k, so a = k^(1/x), b = k^(1/y), c = k^(1/z). b^2 = ac gives 2/y = 1/x + 1/z = (x+z)/xz, so y = 2xz/(x+z).

question_en: If a + b = 6, a - b = 2 then what is the value of 2(a^2 + b^2)?
A man is walking at the speed of 10 km/hr. He takes 5 minutes rest per km. In how much time he will cover 5 km?
explanation_en: Walking time = 5/10 h = 30 min. He rests 4 times (after each of the first 4 km) = 20 min. Total = 50 minutes.

question_en: A wire in the form of a square encloses an area of 289 cm^2. How much area enclosed if the same wire is bent in the form of rectangle of length 19 cm?
explanation_en: Side = 17 cm, so perimeter = 68 cm. Rectangle: 2(19 + b) = 68, so b = 15 cm. Area = 19 x 15 = 285 cm^2.

question_en: What value would come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation? (37)^2 - sqrt(841) + 25% of 580 = ?
The least perfect square number which is divisible by 6, 8, 10 and 11, is:
explanation_en: LCM = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 5 x 11 = 1320. To make it a perfect square, multiply by 2 x 3 x 5 x 11: 2^4 x 3^2 x 5^2 x 11^2 = 435,600.

question_en: On the map, 1/4 cm shows 220 km on the ground. If two cities are actually 2640 km apart on the ground, what will be the distance between them on the map?
explanation_en: 1 km = 1/880 cm on the map, so 2640 km = 2640/880 = 3 cm.

question_en: In a race of 200 metres, Y can give a start of 10 metres to X, and Z can give a start of 20 metres to Y. The start that Z can give to X, in the same race, is:
explanation_en: X : Y = 190 : 200 and Y : Z = 180 : 200, so X : Y : Z = 171 : 180 : 200. Z can give X a start of 200 - 171 = 29 m.

question_en: In the given figure, O is the center of the circle and OC = AC. Find angle ADC.
question_hi: दिए गए चित्र में, O वृत्त का केंद्र है और OC = AC है तो ∠ADC ज्ञात कीजिये?
explanation_en: OA = OC (radii) = AC, so triangle OAC is equilateral and angle AOC = 60 degrees. Angle COD = 180 - 60 = 120 degrees. In isosceles triangle ODC (OD = OC), 2 x angle D = 60, so angle ADC = 30 degrees.

question_en: A committee of 3 members is to be made out of 3 men and 3 women. What is the probability that the committee has at least one man and one woman?
explanation_en: Favourable = 3C1 x 3C2 + 3C2 x 3C1 = 9 + 9 = 18; total = 6C3 = 20. Probability = 18/20 = 9/10.

question_en: A number is as much greater than 17 as it is less than 57. Find the number.
explanation_en: 17 + x = 57 - x gives x = 20, so the number is 17 + 20 = 37.

question_en: The smallest number which when added to 571 gives a number whose square root is 24, will be?
Which among the following is true about saline soils?
question_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा लवणीय मिट्टी के बारे में सही है?
explanation_en: Saline (barren) soils hold a high proportion of water-soluble salts such as sodium, magnesium and calcium chlorides, which accumulate and hinder plant growth. In India they occur mostly in arid and semi-arid regions.

question_en: Which of the following awards was established as the 'Ashoka Chakra, Class III' by the President of India?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पुरस्कार भारत के राष्ट्रपति के द्वारा 'अशोक चक्र, वर्ग III' के रूप में स्थापित किया गया था?
explanation_en: The Shaurya Chakra, a peacetime gallantry award ranking third after the Ashoka and Kirti Chakras, was instituted by the President on 4 January 1952 as 'Ashoka Chakra, Class III'.

question_en: Which of the following personality was not awarded the Nobel Prize in 2022?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस व्यक्तित्व को 2022 में नोबेल पुरस्कार से सम्मानित नहीं किया गया था?
explanation_en: The 2022 Physics Nobel went to Alain Aspect, John F. Clauser and Anton Zeilinger. Former President Pranab Mukherjee received the Bharat Ratna in 2019, not a Nobel.

question_en: The meaning of 'S' in UNESCO is–
question_hi: यूनेस्को में 'एस' का अर्थ है–
explanation_en: UNESCO = United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, so 'S' is Scientific. Founded in 1945, it is headquartered in Paris.

question_en: According to census 2011, which district of India has the Highest Sex Ratio in India per 1000 males?
question_hi: 2011 की जनगणना के अनुसार, भारत के किस जिले में प्रति 1000 पुरुषों पर भारत में सबसे अधिक लिंगानुपात है?
explanation_en: Per Census 2011, Mahe had 1176 females per 1000 males, the highest in India, ahead of Almora (1139) and Kannur (1136).

question_en: FRBM Bill was introduced in the year ______ by the finance minister Yashwant Sinha.
question_hi: FRBM विधेयक वर्ष ______ में वित्त मंत्री यशवंत सिन्हा द्वारा पेश किया गया था।
explanation_en: The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Bill was introduced by Yashwant Sinha in 2000, approved by the Union Cabinet in 2003 and brought into force on 5 July 2004.

question_en: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was signed on October 30, 1947, by how many countries?
question_hi: 30 अक्टूबर 1947 को कितने देशों द्वारा टैरिफ और व्यापार पर सामान्य समझौते (GATT) पर हस्ताक्षर किए गए थे?
explanation_en: 23 countries signed GATT on 30 October 1947 to curb discriminatory trade practices and trade barriers. The WTO replaced it on 1 January 1995.

question_en: What is the rank of India's economy on the basis of purchasing power parity or PPP?
question_hi: क्रय शक्ति समता या पीपीपी के आधार पर भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था का क्या स्थान है?
explanation_en: By PPP, India is the world's third-largest economy after China and the USA. PPP is an economic theory for comparing the currencies of different countries.

question_en: What is the fiscal deficit?
question_hi: राजकोषीय घाटा क्या है?
option_c_en: The sum of the budgetary deficit and the market debt and liabilities of the government
option_d_en: Total loss in the production of all items
option_c_hi: बजटीय घाटे का योग और सरकार का बाज़ार ऋण तथा दायित्व
option_d_hi: सभी वस्तुओं के उत्पादन में कुल हानि
explanation_en: Fiscal deficit reflects the government's total borrowing requirement from all sources over a period. Per the solution: fiscal deficit = budgetary deficit + market borrowings + liabilities.

question_en: ______ argued that industrial society was 'capitalist'.
question_hi: ______ ने तर्क दिया कि औद्योगिक समाज 'पूंजीवादी' था।
explanation_en: Marx saw industrial society as capitalist: capitalists own the capital invested in factories and accumulate the profit produced by workers.

question_en: Among which of the following armies, the battle of Waterloo was fought?
question_hi: वाटरलू का युद्ध निम्नलिखित में से किन सेनाओं के मध्य लड़ा गया था?
option_a_en: Napoleon's French army and British army
option_a_hi: नेपोलियन की फ्रांसीसी सेना और ब्रिटिश सेना
explanation_en: Fought on 18 June 1815 between Napoleon's French army and the British; Napoleon lost, was exiled to St Helena, and died there in 1821.

question_en: What is the commercial cultivation of vegetables called?
question_hi: सब्जियों की व्यापारिक खेती को क्या कहा जाता है?
explanation_en: Olericulture is commercial vegetable growing; sericulture is silkworm rearing, pomiculture is fruit growing, and silviculture is the cultivation of forest trees.

question_en: In which year the Dhuty dam was built under the supervision of Sir George Moss Harriot?
question_hi: सर जॉर्ज मॉस हैरियट की देखरेख में धूती बांध किस वर्ष बनाया गया था?
explanation_en: Built in 1923 under Sir George Moss Harriot on the Wainganga river near Lamta (Balaghat district, MP); its two canals irrigate Lamta and Lalbarra.

question_en: In honour of which Maratha general did Maharani Ahilya Bai Holkar erect the Chhatri at Alampur?
question_hi: महारानी अहिल्या बाई होल्कर ने आलमपुर में छत्री का निर्माण किस मराठा सेनापति के सम्मान में किया था?
explanation_en: Ahilya Bai built the Alampur chhatri in honour of Malhar Rao Holkar; it follows the pattern of the Holkar chhatris at Indore, with decorative floral and leaf carving.

question_en: Which of the following cities was once the capital of Mughal kingdom?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शहर कभी मुगल साम्राज्य की राजधानी था?
explanation_en: Burhanpur, on the north bank of the Tapti in MP, was founded in the 1380s by Nasir Khan of the Faruqi dynasty; after Akbar took Khandesh in 1601 it became capital of the Mughal Khandesh subah.

question_en: Which of the following kings defeated the Hunas in 528 AD?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस राजा ने 528 ई. में हूणों को हराया था?
explanation_en: Yashodharman of Malwa defeated the Huna leader Mihirakula in 528 AD and set up two victory pillars at Mandsaur, possibly with help from the Gupta ruler Narasimhagupta Baladitya.

question_en: The Industrial (Development and Regulation) Act was enacted for the purpose of registration and development of industries in India in ______.
question_hi: औद्योगिक (विकास और विनियमन) अधिनियम भारत में उद्योगों के पंजीकरण और विकास के उद्देश्य से ______ में अधिनियमित किया गया था।
explanation_en: The IDRA was enacted in 1951; its main aim is to regulate and control the development of the country's industries.

question_en: The MP Kamgar Setu Portal has been operated for the welfare of –
question_hi: म.प्र. कामगार सेतु पोर्टल किसके कल्याण के लिए संचालित किया गया है?
explanation_en: Through the portal, small traders and street vendors in rural areas get bank loans of up to ₹10,000, with the full interest borne by the MP government.

question_en: Which Marathi writer has received Saraswati Samman for his book Sanatan?
question_hi: किस मराठी लेखक को उनकी पुस्तक सनातन के लिए सरस्वती सम्मान मिला है?
explanation_en: Sharan Kumar Limbale received the 2020 Saraswati Samman for 'Sanatan'. The 33rd Saraswati Samman (2023) was chosen for Prabha Varma's novel 'Roudra Sathwikam'.

question_en: Who among the following was recently awarded the International Booker Prize 2023?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसे हाल ही में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बुकर पुरस्कार 2023 से सम्मानित किया गया है?
explanation_en: Bulgarian author Georgi Gospodinov won for 'Time Shelter', translated into English by Angela Rodel. The 2024 prize went to Jenny Erpenbeck's 'Kairos', translated by Michael Hofmann.

question_en: World Heart Day is celebrated on–
question_hi: विश्व हृदय दिवस कब मनाया जाता है–
explanation_en: World Heart Day is 29 September. Related days: World Diabetes Day 14 November, World Blood Donor Day 14 June, World Iodine Deficiency Day 21 October.

question_en: Mosquitoes lay eggs in ______ places.
question_hi: मच्छर ______ स्थानों पर अंडे देते हैं।
explanation_en: Mosquitoes breed in waterlogged places such as ponds, swamps, water-treatment sites and other stagnant water bodies.

question_en: The ability to do work is defined as what?
question_hi: कार्य करने की क्षमता को किस रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है?
explanation_en: A body's capacity to do work is its energy — a scalar quantity whose SI unit is the joule.

question_en: The energy used in one hour at the rate of 1kW is known as ______.
question_hi: 1 kW की दर से एक घंटे में उपयोग की जाने वाली ऊर्जा को ______ के रूप में जाना जाता है।
explanation_en: Energy used at 1 kW for one hour is 1 kilowatt-hour: 1 kWh = 1000 W × 3600 s = 3.6 × 10^6 J.

question_en: Full form of FCI is ______.
question_hi: FCI का फुल फॉर्म ______ है।
explanation_en: FCI is the Food Corporation of India, a statutory body set up on 14 January 1965 under the Food Corporations Act, 1964, handling procurement, storage, transport, distribution and sale of food grains.

question_en: Directions: The following question consists of two statements one labeled as 'Assertion' and the other as 'Reason'. You have to examine these two statements carefully and select the correct answer to the question from the given options. Assertion (A): Save water, be vegetarian, don't spoil soil, run in relation to environmental conservation. Reason (R): We all should not try to give back what we are taking from the Earth.
question_hi: निर्देश: निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में दो कथन हैं जिनमें से एक को 'अभिकथन' और दूसरे को 'कारण' के रूप में लेबल किया गया है। आपको इन दोनों कथनों की सावधानीपूर्वक जांच करनी है और दिए गए विकल्पों में से प्रश्न का सही उत्तर चुनना है। अभिकथन (A): जल बचाओ, शाकाहारी बनो, मिट्टी को खराब मत करो, पर्यावरण संरक्षण के लिए दौड़ो। कारण (R): हम सभी को पृथ्वी से जो कुछ हम ले रहे हैं उसे वापस देने का प्रयास नहीं करना चाहिए।
option_a_en: Both A and R are true
option_b_en: Both A and R are false
option_c_en: A is true, but R is false
option_d_en: A is false, but R is true
option_a_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं
option_b_hi: A और R दोनों असत्य हैं
option_c_hi: A सत्य है लेकिन R असत्य है
option_d_hi: A असत्य है लेकिन R सत्य है
explanation_en: The assertion is true but the reason is false: we should in fact try to give back what we take from the Earth.

question_en: ______ factors are the natural calamities or disasters caused due to natural changes.
question_hi: ______ कारक प्राकृतिक परिवर्तन के कारण होने वाली प्राकृतिक आपदाएँ या तबाही हैं।
explanation_en: Natural factors are calamities arising from natural changes — e.g. earthquakes, tectonic tsunamis, tornadoes, floods and volcanic eruptions.

question_en: Which of the following chemicals does not have a place in the kitchen or at home?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस रसायन का रसोई या घर में स्थान नहीं है?
explanation_en: Hydrochloric acid is not used in the kitchen or home, whereas sodium chloride, sodium bicarbonate, bleaching powder (calcium chlorohypochlorite), caustic soda and acetic acid (vinegar) are.

question_en: Who is the inventor of the radio?
question_hi: रेडियो का आविष्कारक कौन है?
explanation_en: Radio – G. Marconi; television – J.L. Baird; dynamo – Michael Faraday; computer – Charles Babbage.

question_en: Which of the following stops the rainwater from flowing away and also reduces soil erosion?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन वर्षा के पानी को बहने से रोकता है और मिट्टी के कटाव को भी कम करता है?
explanation_en: A check dam is a small barrier of soil, stone or cement built across the flow of rainwater, drains or springs; it holds back runoff and reduces soil erosion.

question_en: What is the study of flowers called?
question_hi: फूलों के अध्ययन को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: Per the key, floriculture is the study (cultivation) of flowers; agrostology is the study of grasses and paleontology the study of fossil plants and animals.

question_en: ______ usually have a rigid cell wall made of an inner layer of cellulose and an outer layer of pectose.
question_hi: ______ में आमतौर पर सेल्यूलोज की एक आंतरिक परत और पेक्टोज की एक बाहरी परत से बनी एक कठोर कोशिका भित्ति होती है।
explanation_en: Green algae typically have a rigid wall with an inner cellulose layer and an outer pectose layer, giving structural strength and protection.

question_en: The pteridophytes are classified into how many classes?
question_hi: टेरिडोफाइट्स को कितने वर्गों में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
explanation_en: Pteridophytes fall into four classes — Psilopsida, Lycopsida, Sphenopsida and Pteropsida — and mostly grow in moist, shady places, forests and hills.

question_en: Which one of the following is a green algae?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक हरा शैवाल है?
explanation_en: Chlamydomonas is a unicellular, biflagellate green alga found in both fresh and marine water; about 150 species are known.

question_en: Pyrenoids are present in?
question_hi: पाइरेनोइड्स किसमें मौजूद होते हैं?
explanation_en: Pyrenoids occur mainly in the chloroplasts of green algae; they are small storage bodies containing starch and protein.

question_en: Find the number of triangles in the given figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुजों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: Labelling the four smallest regions 1–4: single regions give 4 triangles, the pairs (1,2), (2,4), (1,3) give 3, and all four together give 1. Total = 4 + 3 + 1 = 8.

question_en: Find the Number of triangles in the figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुजों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: Single-region triangles = 4; triangles formed by two regions (1,2) = 1. Total = 4 + 1 = 5.

question_en: Select the letter-cluster that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster. EGIK : FILO :: FHJL : ?
question_hi: उस अक्षर-समूह का चयन करें जो तीसरे अक्षर-समूह से उसी प्रकार संबंधित है जैसे दूसरा अक्षर-समूह, पहले अक्षर-समूह से संबंधित है। EGIK : FILO :: FHJL : ?
explanation_en: Letters shift by +1, +2, +3, +4: E→F, G→I, I→L, K→O. Likewise F→G, H→J, J→M, L→P, giving GJMP.

question_en: Choose the numbers which is different from others in the group?
question_hi: दिए गए समूह में से विषम संख्या का चयन करें?
explanation_en: In each group every term doubles the previous one (×2, ×2), except 6, 12, 18, where the third term would have to be 24.

question_en: Choose the numbers which is different from others in the group?
question_hi: दिए गए समूह में से विषम संख्या का चयन करें?
explanation_en: In each pair the second number is the first plus 2 (7→9, 13→15, 5→7), but 2 + 2 = 4, not 5.

question_en: Identify the diagram that best represents the relation between Whole Number, Rational Number and Irrational Number?
question_hi: उस आरेख की पहचान करें जो पूर्ण संख्या, परिमेय संख्या और अपरिमेय संख्या के बीच संबंध को सर्वोत्तम रूप से दर्शाता है?
explanation_en: All whole numbers are rational (circle inside circle), while irrational numbers — which cannot be written as p/q with q ≠ 0, e.g. π, √2, √3 — form a separate set. Diagram (b) shows this.

question_en: Find the missing term in the following series. MVPP, NUSS, OTVV, PSYY, ?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित शृंखला में लुप्त पद ज्ञात कीजिए। MVPP, NUSS, OTVV, PSYY, ?
explanation_en: First letters go +1 (M, N, O, P → Q), second letters go −1 (V, U, T, S → R), and the last two letters go +3 (P, S, V, Y → B). Missing term: QRBB.

question_en: What should come in place of question mark (?) in the following question? PNT : RKX :: ? : FEO
question_hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर क्या मान आना चाहिए? PNT : RKX :: ? : FEO
explanation_en: P+2=R, N−3=K, T+4=X. Applying the same steps: D+2=F, H−3=E, K+4=O, so the answer is DHK.

question_en: Which is the wrong term in the following series? 5, 24, 65, 122, 213
explanation_en: Terms follow n³ − 3 for n = 2 to 6: 5, 24, 61, 122, 213. So 65 is wrong; it should be 61.

question_en: In the following question, a certain series of numbers or letters is given of which one series is empty. You have to decide which of the alternative series of the answer will be used in the blank space that is originally related to the sequence of that series. A, 4, C, 9, ?, 14, G, 19
question_hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में, संख्याओं या अक्षरों की एक निश्चित शृंखला दी गई है, जिसमें से एक शृंखला खाली है। आपको यह तय करना है कि मूल रूप से उस शृंखला के अनुक्रम से संबंधित रिक्त स्थान में उत्तर की कौन-सी वैकल्पिक शृंखला का उपयोग किया जाएगा। A, 4, C, 9, ?, 14, G, 19
explanation_en: Letters advance by 2 (A, C, E, G) and numbers by 5 (4, 9, 14, 19), so the blank is E.

question_en: A figure analogy is given below. Understand the logic behind it and complete the analogy for the next figure.
question_hi: एक आकृति सादृश्य नीचे दिया गया है। इसके पीछे के तर्क को समझें और अगली आकृति के लिए सादृश्य को पूर्ण करें।
explanation_en: Just as the full cross in the first figure becomes a smaller inner shape joined to the outer shape by four short segments, the full diagonals of the third figure become an inner square joined to the corners by four short diagonal segments — option (a).

question_en: Select the next figure in the following figure series?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृति शृंखला में अगली आकृति का चयन करें?
explanation_en: The number of black (filled) circles increases by one in each successive figure, so option (d) comes next.

question_en: Identify the class that best represents the Venn-diagram.
question_hi: उस वर्ग की पहचान करें जो वेन-आरेख का सबसे अच्छा प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।
explanation_en: The diagram shows one circle inside another plus a separate circle: buttons are part of a remote, while a TV is a separate item.

question_en: How many quadrilaterals are there in the following figures?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृतियों में कितने चतुर्भुज हैं?
explanation_en: With the four triangles labelled 1–4: two-region quadrilaterals (1,2), (2,3), (3,4) = 3; three-region (1,2,3), (2,3,4) = 2; all four = 1. Total = 6.
