question_en: How many squares are there in the following figure?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृति में कितने वर्ग हैं?
explanation_en: Smallest squares = 20 (16 in the 4×4 grid plus 4 corner squares); 2×2 squares = 9; 3×3 squares = 4; the whole 4×4 square = 1. Total = 34.

question_en: If the mirror is placed on the line, then which of the answer figure is the right mirror image of the given figure?
question_hi: यदि एक दर्पण को दर्शाई गई रेखा पर रखा जाये, तो दी गई विकल्प आकृतियों में से कौन-सी सही दर्पण छवि होगी?
explanation_en: With the mirror on line AB, the left–right reversed image of the potted plant matches option (a).

question_en: Find the odd word/letters/number from the given alternatives.
question_hi: दिए गए विकल्पों में से विषम शब्द/अक्षरों/संख्या को चुनिए।
explanation_en: The product of the second number's digits divided by the first number is a whole number: 6×1×2/6 = 2, 5×2×1/5 = 2, 4×6/4 = 6, but 5×4×3/7 = 60/7 ≈ 8.57 is not.

question_en: In the following question, a statement followed by two conclusions is given. You have to select a conclusion that follows the statement. Statement: Death keeps no calendar. Conclusions: I. Everyone has to die one day. II. Death is a remedy for all ills.
question_hi: निम्न प्रश्न में, एक कथन और उसके नीचे दो निष्कर्ष दिए गए हैं। आपको निष्कर्ष का चयन करना है जो कथन का अनुसरण करता हो। कथन: मृत्यु का कोई कैलेंडर नहीं होता है। निष्कर्ष: I. सभी को एक दिन मरना है। II. मृत्यु सभी बीमारियों का इलाज है।
option_a_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है
option_b_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है
option_c_hi: या तो I या II अनुसरण करता है
option_d_hi: न तो I न ही II अनुसरण करता है
explanation_en: The statement means death can come to anyone at any time, so only conclusion I follows.

question_en: Which of the following is definitely false according to the given equation? D = B ≥ Q ≤ X < F ≤ J > A
question_hi: दिए गए समीकरण के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा निश्चित रूप से असत्य है? D = B ≥ Q ≤ X < F ≤ J > A
explanation_en: The solution finds D = B true, J > X true (J ≥ F > X) and D ≥ Q true (D = B ≥ Q), and marks J ≥ X as false.
note: Key marks (d), but the solution's own chain J ≥ F > X gives J > X, which makes J ≥ X true. All four options are true, so none is definitely false.

question_en: Which of the following is definitely false according to the given equation? F < O = W ≤ Q > R ≥ M > B
question_hi: दिए गए समीकरण के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा निश्चित रूप से असत्य है? F < O = W ≤ Q > R ≥ M > B
option_d_hi: दिए गए विकल्पों में से कोई नहीं
explanation_en: B < Q is true (B < M ≤ R < Q); Q > F is true (Q ≥ W = O > F); Q ≥ M is true (Q > R ≥ M).
note: Key marks (c), yet the worked solution itself ticks Q ≥ M as true (Q > R ≥ M). With (a)–(c) all true, the logically correct answer is (d) None of the given options.

question_en: Radha earns 22% of her investment. If she earns Rs 187, then how much did she invest?
question_hi: राधा अपने निवेश का 22% कमाती है। यदि वह 187 रुपये कमाती है, तो उसने कितना निवेश किया?

question_en: The difference between a number and its two-fifth is 510. What is 10% of that number?
question_hi: एक संख्या और उसके 2/5 भाग के बीच का अंतर 510 है। उस संख्या का 10% क्या है?

question_en: A face cream with an MRP of Rs 160 is available for Rs 154 in a promotion. If the shopkeeper still makes a profit of 10%, what is the cost price of the face cream?
question_hi: एक प्रचार में 160 रुपये की एमआरपी वाली फेस क्रीम 154 रुपये में उपलब्ध है। यदि दुकानदार फिर भी 10% का लाभ कमाता है, तो फेस क्रीम का क्रय मूल्य क्या है?
explanation_en: Selling price ₹154 at 10% profit → cost price = 154 × 100 / 110 = ₹140.

question_en: A girl buys 10 erasers for rupees 12 and sells them at 8 for rupees 15. Find the gain or loss percentage.
question_hi: एक लड़की 12 रुपये में 10 रबड़ खरीदती है और 8 रबड़ 15 रुपये में बेचती है। लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात करें।

question_en: In what time will Rs. 32 becomes Rs. 41 at 25/4% per annum simple interest?
question_hi: 25/4% प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज की दर से 32 रुपये कितने समय में 41 रुपये हो जाएगा?

question_en: 50% of a number is 18 less than two-third of that number. Find the number?
question_hi: एक संख्या का 50% उस संख्या के दो तिहाई से 18 कम है। संख्या का पता लगाएं?

question_en: What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following question? 1 2/3 + 4 2/5 × 6 5/8 ÷ 5 1/2 = ?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर क्या आएगा? 1 2/3 + 4 2/5 × 6 5/8 ÷ 5 1/2 = ?
option_d_hi: दिए गए विकल्पों में से कोई नहीं
explanation_en: As improper fractions: 5/3 + (22/5 × 53/8 × 2/11) = 5/3 + 53/10 = (50 + 159)/30 = 209/30, which matches none of the options.

question_en: If 0.25 is x% of 2.5 then the value of x is
Find the smallest positive number, when subtracted from both the terms of 8 : 9 gives a ratio less than 10 : 13.
question_hi: सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या ज्ञात करें, जिसे जब 8 : 9 के दोनों पदों से घटाया जाता है तो अनुपात 10 : 13 से कम प्राप्त होता है।

question_en: Income ratio of A and B is 1:4 and their expenditure ratio is 2:5. If A saves Rs. 5000 & B saves Rs. 35000, then find the income (in rupees) of A.
question_hi: A और B की आय का अनुपात 1 : 4 है और उनके व्यय का अनुपात 2 : 5 है। यदि A 5000 रुपये बचाता है और B 35,000 रुपये बचाता है तो A की आय (रुपए में) ज्ञात कीजिये।
explanation_en: Let incomes be x and 4x; expenditure = income − savings. (x − 5000)/(4x − 35000) = 2/5 → 5x − 25000 = 8x − 70000 → x = 15000.

question_en: If there is 50% increase in an amount in 5 years due to simple interest, then what will be the compound interest on Rs 30000 after 2 years at the same rate?
question_hi: यदि 5 वर्षों में एक राशि में साधारण ब्याज से 50% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसी दर पर 2 वर्षों के बाद 30000 रुपये पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज कितना होगा?

question_en: At what rate of compound interest per annum, a sum of Rs 1200 becomes Rs 1348.32 in 2 years?
question_hi: प्रतिवर्ष चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की किस दर से 1200 रुपये की राशि 2 वर्षों में 1348.32 रुपये हो जाती है?

question_en: Mohit secured 70% marks in PCS exam and the cutoff was 10 marks more, while Darshan scored 80% marks in the same exam and scored 15 marks more than the cut-off. So what were the passing marks in that exam?
question_hi: मोहित ने पीसीएस परीक्षा में 70% अंक प्राप्त किए और कटऑफ 10 अंक अधिक थी, जबकि दर्शन ने उसी परीक्षा में 80% अंक प्राप्त किए और कटऑफ से 15 अंक अधिक प्राप्त किए। तो उस परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण अंक क्या थे?
explanation_en: Let maximum marks be x. Cut-off = 0.7x + 10 = 0.8x − 15 → 0.1x = 25 → x = 250. Passing marks = 175 + 10 = 185.

question_en: In some quantity of ghee, 60% is pure ghee and 40% is vanaspati. If 20 kg of pure ghee is added, then the strength of vanaspati ghee becomes 20%. The original quantity was?
question_hi: कुछ मात्रा में घी, 60% शुद्ध घी और 40% वनस्पति घी है। यदि 20 किलो शुद्ध घी मिलाया जाता है, तो वनस्पति घी की मात्रा 20% हो जाती है। मूल मात्रा क्या थी?
explanation_en: Vanaspati stays at 0.4x: 0.4x/(x + 20) = 0.2 → 0.4x = 0.2x + 4 → x = 20 kg.

question_en: The speed of a train is 75km/h. The distance covered by the train in 6 seconds is:
question_hi: एक ट्रेन की गति 75 किमी/घंटा है। ट्रेन द्वारा 6 सेकंड में तय की गई दूरी है:
explanation_en: 75 km/h = 75 × 5/18 = 125/6 m/s; in 6 s the train covers 125/6 × 6 = 125 m.

question_en: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 65 + 2 – 25 ÷ 5 × 12 = 137
question_hi: दिए गए समीकरण को सही बनाने के लिए किन दो चिह्नों को आपस में बदला जाना चाहिए? 65 + 2 – 25 ÷ 5 × 12 = 137

question_en: Which of the following cube in the answer figure cannot be made based on the unfolded cube in the question figure?
question_hi: उत्तर आकृति में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा घन प्रश्न आकृति में खुले घन के आधार पर नहीं बनाया जा सकता है?
explanation_en: Opposite faces are Anil–Sonu, Tinku–Sorav and Monu–Geeta. Option (c) shows Sonu and Anil on adjacent faces, which is impossible since opposite faces are never adjacent.

question_en: If '–' means '+', '+' means '×', '×' means '÷' and '÷' means '–', then 40 ÷ 30 – 20 × 8 + 2 = ?
explanation_en: After substitution: 40 − 30 + 20 ÷ 8 × 2 = 10 + 5 = 15.
note: The printed English/Hindi text garbles the sign symbols (e.g. "'×' means '+'", "'+' means '–'", expression starting "40 + 30"); the text here follows the mapping used in the worked solution.

question_en: What was the day of week on 2 October 1869?
question_hi: 2 अक्टूबर 1869 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
explanation_en: Odd days: 1800 years → 3; the 68 years 1801–1868 (17 leap years) → 85 days → 1; 1 Jan–2 Oct 1869 (275 days) → 2. Total 6 odd days = Saturday.

question_en: If the day before yesterday was Friday, what day will two days after the day after tomorrow be?
question_hi: यदि परसों का दिन शुक्रवार था, तो परसों के दो दिन बाद कौन-सा दिन होगा?
explanation_en: Day before yesterday = Friday, so today is Sunday; day after tomorrow is Tuesday; two days after that is Thursday.

question_en: At what time between 6 to 7 O' clock minute and hour hand will coincide?
question_hi: 6 से 7 बजे के बीच किस समय मिनट और घंटे की सुई एक साथ होंगी?
explanation_en: Hands coincide (θ = 0°) at M = (2/11) × (6 × 30) = 360/11 = 32 8/11 minutes past 6.

question_en: If 40 minutes ago, it was 25 minutes past five O' clock, how many minutes is it until seven O' clock?
question_hi: यदि 40 मिनट पहले, पाँच बजकर 25 मिनट हुए थे, तो सात बजने में कितने मिनट बचे हैं?
explanation_en: Current time = 5:25 + 40 min = 6:05, leaving 55 minutes until 7:00.

question_en: In the following equation, select correct combination of mathematical signs to replace A and balance the equation. 187 A 136 A 32 A 61 A 17
question_hi: निम्नलिखित समीकरण में, A को प्रतिस्थापित करने और समीकरण को संतुलित करने के लिए गणितीय चिह्नों के सही संयोजन का चयन करें। 187 A 136 A 32 A 61 A 17
explanation_en: With ÷, ×, =, −: 187 ÷ 136 × 32 = 44 and 61 − 17 = 44, so both sides balance.

question_en: If red is called yellow, yellow is called orange, orange is called pink, pink is called green, green is called purple and purple is called black. Then what is the colour of a leaf?
question_hi: यदि लाल को पीला कहा जाए, पीले को नारंगी कहा जाए, नारंगी को गुलाबी कहा जाए, गुलाबी को हरा कहा जाए, हरे को बैंगनी कहा जाए और बैंगनी को काला कहा जाए। तो एक पत्ती का रंग कैसा होता है?
explanation_en: A leaf is green, and green is called purple.

question_en: If cow is called sparrow, sparrow is called hen, hen is called peacock, peacock is called cock, cock is called eagle and eagle is called nightingale. Which one of the following is a national bird?
question_hi: यदि गाय को गौरैया कहा जाए, गौरैया को मुर्गी कहा जाए, मुर्गी को मोर कहा जाए, मोर को मुर्गा कहा जाए, मुर्गे को चील कहा जाए और चील को कोकिला कहा जाए। निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक राष्ट्रीय पक्षी है?
explanation_en: The national bird is the peacock, and peacock is called cock.

question_en: Find the next term in the series. ZA, UF, QJ, ?, LO
question_hi: शृंखला का अगला पद ज्ञात करें। ZA, UF, QJ, ?, LO
explanation_en: First letters: Z −5 U −4 Q −3 N −2 L. Second letters: A +5 F +4 J +3 M +2 O. Missing term: NM.

question_en: Arrange the following words as per order in the dictionary. (1) Host (2) Haphazard (3) Haste (4) Hang (5) Handkerchief
question_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों को शब्दकोश में दिए गए क्रम के अनुसार लिखिए? (1) Host (2) Haphazard (3) Haste (4) Hang (5) Handkerchief
explanation_en: Dictionary order: Handkerchief, Hang, Haphazard, Haste, Host → 5, 4, 2, 3, 1.

question_en: Which one word can be formed from the following letters? r o l e c h b a
question_hi: निम्नलिखित अक्षरों से कौन-सा एक शब्द बनाया जा सकता है? r o l e c h b a
explanation_en: The letters r, o, l, e, c, h, b, a rearrange exactly into 'bachelor'.

question_en: In a certain code 'GIVE' is written as 'VIEG' and 'OVER' is written as 'EVRO'. How will 'DISK' be written in that code?
question_hi: किसी कूट भाषा में 'GIVE' को 'VIEG' के रूप में लिखा जाता है और 'OVER' को 'EVRO' के रूप में लिखा जाता है। उसी कूट भाषा में 'DISK' को कैसे लिखेंगे?
explanation_en: Letters are rearranged as 3rd, 2nd, 4th, 1st: GIVE → VIEG, OVER → EVRO, so DISK → SIKD.

question_en: If FATHER = 7 and DAUGHTER = 9, then DISTANT = ______.
question_hi: यदि FATHER = 7 और DAUGHTER = 9, तो DISTANT = ______.
explanation_en: Code = number of letters + 1: FATHER (6) → 7, DAUGHTER (8) → 9, DISTANT (7) → 8.

question_en: Find the lowest common multiple of 15, 35 and 55.
question_hi: 15, 35 और 55 का सबसे छोटा सार्व गुणज ज्ञात कीजिए।

question_en: Find the HCF and LCM of 60 and 120 by prime factorization method.
question_hi: अभाज्य गुणनखंड विधि द्वारा 60 और 120 का HCF और LCM ज्ञात कीजिए।

question_en: If 2^x = ∛32, then x is equal:
question_hi: यदि 2^x = ∛32, है तो x का मान है:

question_en: If a^x = b, b^y = c and c^z = a, then the value of xyz is:
question_hi: यदि a^x = b, b^y = c और c^z = a, है तो xyz का मान है
explanation_en: a = c^z = (b^y)^z = b^(yz) = (a^x)^(yz) = a^(xyz), so xyz = 1.

question_en: If a³ – b³ = 56 and a – b = 2 then what is the value of (a² + b²)?
question_hi: यदि a³ – b³ = 56 और a – b = 2 हो तो (a² + b²) का मान क्या होगा?
explanation_en: a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b) → 56 = 8 + 6ab → ab = 8. Then a² + b² = (a − b)² + 2ab = 4 + 16 = 20.

question_en: If a man walks to his office from his house at the speed of 4 km/hr, he gets late for 5 minutes. If he goes at the speed of 5 km/hr, then he reaches 4 minutes early. What is the distance between his house and office?
question_hi: घर से 4 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चलकर जाने पर एक व्यक्ति अपने कार्यालय 5 मिनट देरी से पहुँचता है। यदि वह 5 किमी/घंटा की चाल से कार्यालय जाये, तो 4 मिनट जल्दी पहुँचता है। उसके घर से कार्यालय की दूरी क्या है?
explanation_en: Time difference = 5 + 4 = 9 min = 9/60 h. x/4 − x/5 = 9/60 → x/20 = 3/20 → x = 3 km.

question_en: Three cubes of sides 6 cm, 8 cm and 1 cm are melted to form a new cube. The surface area of the new cube is
question_hi: 6 सेमी, 8 सेमी और 1 सेमी भुजा वाले तीन घनों को पिघलाकर एक नया घन बनाया जाता है। नए घन का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल है
explanation_en: New volume = 216 + 512 + 1 = 729 cm³, so side = 9 cm. Surface area = 6 × 9² = 486 cm².

question_en: What value would come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation? 38% of 450 + 28% of 150 – 45% of 260 = ?% of 600
question_hi: निम्नलिखित समीकरण में प्रश्नवाचक चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर क्या मान आएगा? 450 का 38% + 150 का 28% – 260 का 45% = 600 का ?%

question_en: On adding 4116 to the greatest three-digit number, it will be completely divisible by 9, 15, 16, and 20. Find out the number.
question_hi: 4116 को सबसे बड़ी तीन अंकों की संख्या में जोड़ने पर यह 9, 15, 16 और 20 से पूर्णतः विभाजित हो जाएगी। संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: LCM(9, 15, 16, 20) = 720. 4116 + 924 = 5040 = 720 × 7, divisible by all four; the next multiple (5760) would need a four-digit addend.

question_en: The distance of 1/2cm on a map represents 300 km on the ground. If two cities are 900 km apart on the ground, then their distance on the map will be.
question_hi: मानचित्र पर 1/2 सें.मी की दूरी जमीन पर 300 कि.मी. को प्रदर्शित करती है। यदि दो शहर जमीन पर एक-दूसरे से 900 किलोमीटर की दूरी पर हैं, तो मानचित्र पर उनकी दूरी क्या होगी।
explanation_en: 1 km on the ground = 1/600 cm on the map, so 900 km = 900/600 = 1.5 cm.

question_en: Shyam travels 400 km by train at 60km/hr, 300 km by ship at 40 km/hr, 200 km by aeroplane at 300 km/hr and 50 km by car at 40km/hr. What is the average speed for the entire distance?
question_hi: श्याम 60 किमी/घंटा से ट्रेन द्वारा 400 किमी, 40 किमी/घंटा से जहाज द्वारा 300 किमी, 300 किमी/घंटा से हवाई जहाज द्वारा 200 किमी और 40 किमी/घंटा से कार द्वारा 50 किमी की यात्रा करता है। संपूर्ण दूरी के लिए औसत गति क्या है?
explanation_en: Average speed = total distance / total time = 950 / (400/60 + 300/40 + 200/300 + 50/40) = 950 × 12/193 ≈ 59.06 km/h.
note: The computed 59.06 km/h matches none of the options; the source marks the answer as (*), i.e. no correct option.

question_en: In the given figure, O is the center of the circle, ∠OAB = 80° and ∠OCB = 70°. What is the measure of ∠AOC?
question_hi: दिए गए चित्र में, O वृत्त का केंद्र है, ∠OAB = 80° और ∠OCB = 70° है। ∠AOC का माप क्या है?
explanation_en: OA = OB = OC (radii), so ∠OBA = 80° and ∠OBC = 70°. In quadrilateral OABC: 80 + 80 + 70 + 70 + ∠AOC = 360°, giving ∠AOC = 60°.

question_en: There are 3 green, 4 orange and 5 white color bulbs in a bag. If a bulb is picked at random, what is the probability of having either a green or a white bulb?
question_hi: एक बैग में 3 हरे, 4 नारंगी और 5 सफेद रंग के बल्ब हैं। यदि एक बल्ब यादृच्छिक रूप से चुना जाता है, तो हरे या सफेद बल्ब के होने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
explanation_en: Total bulbs = 12; green or white = 8; probability = 8/12 = 2/3.

question_en: One fifth of a number exceeds its one seventh by 154. Find the number.
question_hi: एक संख्या का पाँचवाँ भाग इसके एक-सातवें भाग से 154 अधिक है। संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

explanation_en: Sum of squares n(n + 1)(2n + 1)/6 with n = 10: 10 × 11 × 21 / 6 = 385.

question_en: Choose the Kharif crop.
explanation_en: Kharif crops are sown in June-July and harvested in October-November (e.g. jowar, maize, bajra, rice, cotton). Rabi crops such as wheat, mustard, barley and gram are sown in October-November and harvested in March-April.

question_en: Which of the following Indian personalities received the Right Livelihood Award in 1984?
explanation_en: The Right Livelihood Award, started in 1980, honours practical solutions to major global problems. Ela Bhatt received it in 1984.

question_en: Chihil Sutun are a ____ hall which were made by Mughals.
explanation_en: Chihil Sutun is a forty-pillared hall built under Shah Jahan, whose reign is regarded as the golden age of Mughal architecture.

question_en: Kabul and Dhaka are the capitals of which two countries respectively?
explanation_en: Kabul is the capital of Afghanistan and Dhaka of Bangladesh (Sri Lanka: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte; Myanmar: Naypyidaw; Pakistan: Islamabad).

question_en: Who has the authority to increase the Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) ratio by up to 40%?
explanation_en: The Reserve Bank of India (established 1 April 1935, headquartered in Mumbai) regulates banks and fixes the SLR, the minimum share of deposits banks must hold as liquid assets such as cash, gold or approved securities.

question_en: Which type of ports are specialised in bulk cargo like grain, sugar, ore, oil, chemicals and similar materials?
explanation_en: Industrial ports handle industrial and commercial traffic, including container and energy terminals, and specialise in bulk cargo such as grain, sugar, ore, oil and chemicals.

question_en: Which of the following country is not located on the 'Ring of Fire' and in which ocean is Ring of Fire found?
explanation_en: The Ring of Fire is a chain of volcanoes and earthquake zones around the Pacific Ocean, hosting most active volcanoes and earthquakes. Japan, Indonesia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Chile etc. lie on it; India lies in the Indian Ocean region and does not.

question_en: When was the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India established?
explanation_en: TRAI was set up in 1997 with headquarters in New Delhi to protect consumer interests and develop telecom, broadcasting and cable services.

question_en: Who are the Revenue Inspectors?
explanation_en: Per the key, the Tehsildar; revenue inspectors and tehsildars both oversee revenue-department matters at the tehsil level, and the tehsildar is a land-revenue officer.

question_en: Which of the following books was written by German philosopher Karl Marx?
explanation_en: Marx wrote The Communist Manifesto and Das Kapital. Divine Comedy is by Dante, The Prince by Machiavelli, and Anna Karenina by Tolstoy.

question_en: In which of the following places, Napoleon Bonaparte was born?
explanation_en: Napoleon was born on 15 August 1769 in Ajaccio (Corsica), France. He rose as a general during the French Revolution and ruled France from 1804 to 1814 and briefly in 1815.

question_en: Which of the following is related to "Stock Farming"?
option_d_en: Use of fertilizers at large scale
explanation_en: Stock farming means rearing and breeding livestock. It complements agriculture by supplying manure, draught power and fodder use, and yields milk, meat, eggs, wool and leather.

question_en: In which year the Kamalapati Mahal of Bhopal was built?
explanation_en: Kamalapati Mahal in Bhopal was built in 1722 by Nizam Shah for the Gond queen Kamalapati, in Indo-Islamic style.

question_en: Which Mughal emperor used to reside at the Shahi Kila, when he was the governor of Burhanpur?
explanation_en: Shah Jahan (Shahab-ud-din Muhammad Khurram) served as governor of several provinces under Jahangir and resided at the Shahi Kila in Burhanpur; he became emperor in 1628.

question_en: Between 1720-1760 ____ took control of most of the Madhya Pradesh.
explanation_en: The Maratha Empire, founded by Chhatrapati Shivaji, took control of most of Madhya Pradesh between 1720 and 1760.

question_en: Even during the period when Madhya Pradesh came under Mughal Empire, Mahakoshal remained under the control of–
explanation_en: Mahakoshal, the region north and east of the Narmada, remained under Gond rule even while Madhya Pradesh was part of the Mughal Empire.

question_en: Apart from the Principal seat of High Court, how many permanent benches of High Court are there in Madhya Pradesh?
explanation_en: The MP High Court's principal seat is at Jabalpur. Temporary benches at Indore and Gwalior were created in 1956 and made permanent on 28 November 1968.

question_en: According to Madhya Pradesh Budget 2023-24, how much amount is the provision for the Prime Minister's Housing Scheme?
explanation_en: The MP Budget 2023-24 allocated Rs 8000 crore to the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana.

question_en: Who received the Best Actor award in Oscar Awards 2023?
explanation_en: Brendan Fraser won Best Actor at the 2023 Oscars for his role in 'The Whale'.

question_en: According to the National Panchayat Awards 2023 which state has won the Best District Panchayats Awards?
explanation_en: Ganjam district of Odisha won the Best District Panchayat award in 2023.

question_en: Heart attack can be caused due to ____ blood supply to the heart.
explanation_en: A heart attack occurs when heart muscle does not receive enough blood/oxygen. Risk factors include coronary artery disease, plaque, diabetes, high blood pressure and high cholesterol.

question_en: The poison of honey bee is:
explanation_en: Honey bee venom is acidic and contains enzymes, proteins and peptides; the protein melittin makes up about 50-60% of it.

question_en: Which among the following can neither be created nor be destroyed, but it can be changed from one form to another?
explanation_en: By the law of conservation of energy (first law of thermodynamics), energy cannot be created or destroyed, only converted from one form to another.

question_en: When the time is taken to complete a given amount of work increases:
explanation_en: Power = work/time, so for the same work, taking more time means lower power.

question_en: Which one is wrong about the factors affecting the environment?
explanation_en: Per the key, the listed environmental factors are urbanisation, pollution, cyclones, population growth, industrialisation, light, temperature and humidity; agriculture is not among them.

question_en: Assertion (A): Hunting in the long run results in disturbance of the biological diversity present in an ecosystem. Reason (R): This would ultimately affect the food chain as well as the living beings.
option_a_en: Both A and R are true
option_b_en: Both A and R are false
option_c_en: A is true but R is false
option_d_en: A is false but R is true
explanation_en: Hunting contributes to species loss, and loss of species ultimately disrupts food chains and other living beings, so both statements are true.

question_en: Man-made factors are caused due to the activities of human beings. Which does not include the man made factor?
explanation_en: Pesticide use, mining and overgrazing are human-caused; drought, like earthquakes and tsunamis, is a natural factor.

question_en: The nitrogen fertilizer with the highest percentage of nitrogen is:
explanation_en: Urea contains about 46% nitrogen, versus about 35% in ammonium nitrate and 15.5% in calcium nitrate.

question_en: Which of the following is the substance found in more than 80 percent of the cell?
explanation_en: Water is the most abundant cell constituent (roughly 70-80% of cell mass), followed by proteins, fats and carbohydrates.

question_en: What causes the yellow colour of papaya?
explanation_en: Papaya's yellow colour comes from caricaxanthin (tomato: lycopene; carrot: carotene; beetroot: betanin).

question_en: Which of the following awards is known as Green Oscar?
explanation_en: The Whitley Awards, given annually by the Whitley Fund for Nature for nature conservation, are known as the 'Green Oscar'.

question_en: The members of rhodophyceae are commonly called ____.
explanation_en: Rhodophyceae are red algae, coloured by the pigment r-phycoerythrin; they also contain chlorophyll a and d.

question_en: The leaves in gymnosperms are well-adapted to withstand extremes of ____
explanation_en: Gymnosperm leaves are adapted to extremes of temperature, humidity and wind. Gymnosperms have naked seeds and no flowers or fruits (e.g. pine, deodar, cycas).

question_en: Amarbel is an example of ____
explanation_en: Amarbel (Cuscuta, dodder) is a parasite that twines on trees like babul and ber and draws food from them; it lacks leaves and chlorophyll.

question_en: Which of the following is a Seedless vascular plant?
explanation_en: Ferns have vascular tissue for water and nutrient transport but bear neither seeds nor flowers; they reproduce by spores.

question_en: Find the number of triangles in the given figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुज की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: The worked solution counts 5 single triangles, 2 made of two parts and 1 made of four parts, i.e. 8 triangles.
note: Key marked (*): the solution's count of 8 matches none of the options.

question_en: Find the number of triangles in the given figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुज की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: Only two triangles are formed in the figure.

question_en: Select the letter-cluster that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster. CAT : DDY :: BIG : ?
explanation_en: Letters shift by +1, +3, +5: C→D, A→D, T→Y. Likewise B→C, I→L, G→L gives CLL.

question_en: Choose the numbers which is different from others in the group?
explanation_en: In (a), (b) and (c) the middle number equals the difference of the outer two (3-2=1, 9-5=4, 3-1=2); in (d) 40-11=29, not 9, so the worked solution picks (d).
note: Worked solution gives (d), but the commission's official key accepted (c).

question_en: Choose the numbers which is different from others in the group?
explanation_en: In each pair the second number is the cube of the first number's digit sum: 1+1=2, 2^3=8; 7+3=10, 10^3=1000; 6+2=8, 8^3=512. For 32-25, 3+2=5 and 25 is 5^2, not a cube.

question_en: In the given diagram 'A' indicates the person who plays Football, 'B' indicates the person who plays Cricket and 'C' indicates the person who plays Hockey. What does 'D' indicate in the figure?
question_hi: दिए गए आरेख में 'A' फुटबॉल खेलने वाले व्यक्ति को इंगित करता है, 'B' क्रिकेट खेलने वाले व्यक्ति को इंगित करता है और 'C' हॉकी खेलने वाले व्यक्ति को इंगित करता है। चित्र में 'D' क्या दर्शाता है?
explanation_en: D lies in the common region of all three circles, so it represents a person who plays football, cricket and hockey.

question_en: Find the missing term in the following series. PAM, TEI, XIE, BMA, ?
explanation_en: First letters +4 (P,T,X,B,F), second letters +4 (A,E,I,M,Q), third letters -4 (M,I,E,A,W): FQW.

question_en: Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term. HLP : MQU :: EIK : ?
explanation_en: Each letter is shifted +5: H→M, L→Q, P→U; so E→J, I→N, K→P gives JNP.

question_en: Which is the wrong term in the following series? 39, 46, 60, 83, 109, 144, 186
explanation_en: Differences should be +7, +14, +21, +28, +35, +42. 60+21=81, so 83 is wrong.

question_en: A certain series of numbers or letters is given of which one term is missing. Choose the alternative that fits the blank in the sequence. D4, G8, J16, M32, ?
explanation_en: Letters advance by +3 (D,G,J,M,P) and numbers double (4,8,16,32,64): P64.

question_en: A figure analogy is given below. Understand the logic behind it and complete the analogy for the next figure.
question_hi: एक आकृति सादृश्य नीचे दिया गया है। इसके पीछे के तर्क को समझें और अगली आकृति के लिए सादृश्य को पूर्ण करें।
explanation_en: The square is completed by joining all its vertices (drawing its diagonals); likewise, joining all five vertices of the pentagon gives the pentagram-inside-pentagon figure, option (b).

question_en: Select the next figure in the following figure series.
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृति श्रृंखला में अगली आकृति का चयन करें?
explanation_en: The second figure is the mirror image of the first; similarly the fourth is the mirror image of the third, which is option (c).

question_en: Identify the class that best represents the Venn-diagram.
question_hi: उस वर्ग की पहचान करें जो वेन-आरेख का सबसे अच्छा प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।
explanation_en: Girlfriend and widow are overlapping subsets inside the larger set of women, matching the diagram.

question_en: How many squares are there in the following figure?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृति में कितने वर्ग हैं?

question_en: How many triangles are in the given figure?
question_hi: दी गई आकृति में कितने त्रिभुज हैं?
explanation_en: The worked solution labels 10 regions and counts 8+6+2+5+2+2+1 = 26 triangles.
note: Key marked (*): the solution's count of 26 matches none of the options.

question_en: If the mirror is placed on the line, then which of the answer figure is the right mirror image of the given figure?
question_hi: यदि एक दर्पण को दर्शाई गई रेखा पर रखा जाये, तो दी गई विकल्प आकृतियों में से कौन-सी सही दर्पण छवि होगी?
explanation_en: Reflecting the block figure in the vertical mirror line on its right gives option (b).

question_en: Find the odd word/letters/number from the given alternatives.
explanation_en: In (a), (c) and (d) the second number is the first with its digits reversed; 45-74 is not, so it is the odd one.

question_en: Statement: Angola is the most expensive country. Conclusions: I. Singapore is less expensive than Angola. II. Switzerland is the cheapest country.
explanation_en: If Angola is the most expensive, every other country (including Singapore) is less expensive, so I follows; nothing supports Switzerland being the cheapest.

question_en: What should come in place of question mark? BAT DCV FEX HGZ ?
explanation_en: Each letter position advances by +2: B,D,F,H,J; A,C,E,G,I; T,V,X,Z,B. Answer JIB.

question_en: What should come in place of question mark? BBC GFF LJI QNL ?
explanation_en: First letters +5 (B,G,L,Q,V), second +4 (B,F,J,N,R), third +3 (C,F,I,L,O): VRO.

question_en: A football team wins 7 games, which is 35% of the total games played. How many games were played in all?
Two numbers are 20% and 30% less than the third number. How much percent is the second number less than first?
explanation_en: Take the third number as 100: first = 80, second = 70. The second is 10/80 x 100 = 12.5% less than the first.

question_en: The profit made after selling a product at Rs 625 is the same as the loss made after selling the same product at Rs 275. Find the cost price of the product.
If the cost price of a chicken is 200. Selling price of the chicken is 120. Find the gain or loss percentage?
What sum of money must be given at simple interest for six months at 5% per annum in order to earn Rs. 100 interest?
explanation_en: For 6 months the rate is 2.5% per half-year: 100 = P x 2.5 x 1/100, so P = Rs 4000.
note: Options (b) and (c) are both printed as Rs 4000; the key gives (b).

question_en: The difference between two numbers is 1550. If 8% of one number is 10% of the other number, then find the two numbers.
explanation_en: 8x = 10y gives x:y = 5:4; the difference of 1 part = 1550, so the numbers are 7750 and 6200.

question_en: If the cost of a notebook is Rs. 144/7, how many notebooks can be purchased for Rs. 12/7?
explanation_en: Number = (12/7)/(144/7) = 12/144 = 1/12, which is not among the numeric options.
25% of 100x = 25x and 2.5% of 200x = 5x; total 30x.

question_en: Two natural numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5 and their product is 3380. Find the smallest number.
explanation_en: 4x x 5x = 3380, so x^2 = 169 and x = 13; the smaller number is 4 x 13 = 52.

question_en: If a : b = 3 : 4 and b : c = 3 : 8, then 2a : 3b : 7c is equal to:
A sum of money increases 40% in 5 years at simple interest. What will be the compound interest on Rs.15000 after 3 years at the same rate?
Find the compound interest on Rs 48,000 for one year at 8% per annum when compounded half-yearly.
explanation_en: Half-yearly rate 4% for 2 periods: A = 48000 x (1.04)^2 = 51916.80, so CI = Rs 3916.80.

question_en: If Praveen salary is reduced by 40% and then after sometime it is further reduced by 40%, then what will be Praveen loss in terms of percentage?

The price of an article, passing through three hands, rises on the whole 195%. If the first and the second sellers earned 20% and 25% profit respectively, find the percentage profit earned by the third seller.
explanation_en: The solution treats the final price as 195% of the original: 1.20 x 1.25 x (1+x/100) = 1.95, giving 1+x/100 = 1.30 and x = 30%.

question_en: Which of the following speeds is the least?
explanation_en: Per second: 50 m, 5/6 m, about 19.44 m and about 83.33 m respectively, so 50 m/min is the least.

question_en: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 12 × 6 ÷ 18 – 9 + 13 = 83
Three positions of a cube are shown below. What will come opposite to face containing '*'?
question_hi: एक घन की तीन स्थितियाँ नीचे दर्शाई गई हैं। '*' वाले फलक के विपरीत क्या आयेगा?
explanation_en: Comparing the second and third positions, the face opposite '*' is $.

question_en: If a means –, b means +, c means ÷, d means ×, then 21 b 13 a 24 c 8 d 2 = ?
explanation_en: 21 + 13 – 24 ÷ 8 × 2 = 21 + 13 – 6 = 28. (The English stem prints 'c means +'; the solution uses c as ÷.)

question_en: What was the day of week on 26 November 2008?
explanation_en: Odd days: 0 up to 2000, 1 for the next 7 years, and 2 from 1 January to 26 November 2008; total 3 odd days, i.e. Wednesday.

question_en: Anu is 300 days older than Varun and Sandeep is 50 weeks older than Anu. If Sandeep was born on Tuesday, on which day was Varun born?
explanation_en: Sandeep is 350 + 300 = 650 days older than Varun; 650 = 92 weeks + 6 days. The printed solution subtracts 6 days from Tuesday to get Wednesday, which is not an option.
note: Key marked (*). Since Varun is younger, he was born 650 days after Sandeep; Tuesday + 6 days = Monday, which suggests option (a).

question_en: At what time between 10 to 11 O'clock minute and hour hand will coincide?
explanation_en: Hands coincide when the angle is 0: minutes = (2/11)(10 x 30) = 600/11 = 54 6/11, so 10:54 6/11.

question_en: If 30 minutes ago, it was 15 minutes past five O'clock, how many minutes is it until six O'clock?
explanation_en: Now it is 5:15 + 30 min = 5:45, so 15 minutes remain until 6:00.

question_en: In the following equation, select correct combination of mathematical signs to replace A and balance the equation. 259 A 21 A 9 A 11 A 100
If teacher is called butler, butler is called washerman, washerman is called tailor, tailor is called policeman, policeman is called cook and cook is called postman, then who stitches clothes?
explanation_en: A tailor stitches clothes, and a tailor is called 'policeman' in this code.

question_en: If stove is called refrigerator, refrigerator is called air conditioner, air conditioner is called cooler, cooler is called cupboard and cupboard is called television. Which one of the following is used for cooking food?
explanation_en: Food is cooked on a stove, and a stove is called 'refrigerator' in this code.

question_en: Find the next term in the series. AG, CH, FJ, ?, OQ
explanation_en: First letters increase by +2, +3, +4, +5 (A,C,F,J,O); second letters by +1, +2, +3, +4 (G,H,J,M,Q). Missing term: JM.

question_en: Arrange the following words as per order in the dictionary. (1) Save (2) Sausage (3) Saviour (4) Savour (5) Savage
explanation_en: Dictionary order: Sausage, Savage, Save, Saviour, Savour = 2, 5, 1, 3, 4.

question_en: Which one word can be formed from the following letters? a b g r o w s m
explanation_en: The letters a, b, g, r, o, w, s, m spell 'bagworms'.

question_en: In a certain code language the word EXAMPLES is written as EMAXSEPL. How will the word BUOYANCY be written in that language?
explanation_en: Letter positions are rearranged in the order 7,4,3,2,8,1,5,6; applying the same to BUOYANCY gives CYOUYBAN.

question_en: Select the option that gives the correct explanation for the following group of words. Bridge, Link, Chain
explanation_en: A bridge, a link and a chain each connect two parts.

question_en: Find the least perfect square number when divided by 4, 9, 15, 21 leaves remainder 36.
Find the least number which when divided by 3, 4, 5, 6 leaves a remainder 2, but when divided by 7 leaves no remainder.
explanation_en: LCM(3,4,5,6) = 60, so the number is 60k + 2: 62, 122, 182, ... The first divisible by 7 is 182.

question_en: What is the H.C.F. of 15/9, 35/24 and 20/33?
explanation_en: HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators / LCM of denominators = HCF(15,35,20) / LCM(9,24,33) = 5/792.

question_en: If 2^x × 8^(1/5) = 2^(1/5), then x is equal to
If 2^x = 4^y = 8^z and (1/(2x) + 1/(4y) + 1/(6z)) = 24/7, then the value of z is:
explanation_en: 2^x = 2^(2y) = 2^(3z) gives x = 2y = 3z. Each term becomes 1/(6z), so 3/(6z) = 24/7 and z = 7/48.

question_en: If x^3 + y^3 = 35 and x + y = 5, then value of (1/x + 1/y) is?
Two cyclist A and B start cycling at 21 km/hr and 24 km/hr towards each other. They meet after 1 hour and 12 minutes. How far (in km) were they from each other when they started?
explanation_en: Relative speed = 45 km/h, time = 6/5 h, distance = 45 x 6/5 = 54 km.

question_en: If one small square in the grid is of area 4 sq. units, what is the perimeter of the rectangle drawn on the grid?
question_hi: यदि ग्रिड में एक छोटा वर्ग 4 वर्ग इकाइयों का है, तो ग्रिड पर बनाए गए आयत का परिमाप क्या है?
explanation_en: Each small square has side 2. The rectangle is 4 squares by 2 squares, i.e. 8 by 4, so perimeter = 2(8 + 4) = 24 units. (The rectangle outline is only visible in the solution figure.)

question_en: What value would come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation? 2 1/2 + 3 4/5 + 2 1/6 - 4 1/3 = ?
On a map 3cm shows 1km on ground, if two stations are 1000km apart on the ground, then find the distance between them on the map.
explanation_en: 1 km = 3 cm on the map, so 1000 km = 3000 cm.

question_en: A passenger train of length 150 m at certain speed and goods train of length 60 m at a speed of 54 km/h crosses each other in 6 seconds running in the opposite direction. If a passenger train takes 45 seconds to cross a bridge of length A m, then find the length of bridge.
explanation_en: Goods train speed = 15 m/s. 210/(15 + x) = 6 gives x = 20 m/s. Then (150 + A)/20 = 45 gives A = 750 m.

question_en: The perpendicular distance between two equal and parallel chords in a circle is 12 cm. If the radius of the circle is 10 cm, what is the length of each chord?
explanation_en: Each chord is 6 cm from the centre; half-chord = sqrt(10^2 - 6^2) = 8 cm, so the chord is 16 cm.

question_en: A box contains 6 pink, 4 red and 5 yellow marbles. If 2 marbles are picked at random, then find the probability that both the marbles are either yellow or pink?
explanation_en: Both pink or both yellow: (6C2 + 5C2)/15C2 = (15 + 10)/105 = 5/21.

question_en: If 20/x = x/45, then x = ?
The sum of the smallest four-digit number and the largest three-digit number is:
What is shifting cultivation called in Mexico & Malaysia respectively?
question_hi: मेक्सिको और मलेशिया में झूम खेती को क्रमशः क्या कहा जाता है?
explanation_en: Shifting cultivation is called Milpa in Mexico and Ladang in Malaysia; Roca is the Brazilian term. Other local names: Ray (Vietnam), Tavy (Madagascar), Conuco (Venezuela), Tamrai (Thailand), Chena (Sri Lanka), Logan (West Africa).
explanation_hi: मेक्सिको में झूम खेती को मिल्पा और मलेशिया में लडांग कहते हैं; रोका ब्राज़ील का नाम है। अन्य नाम: रे (वियतनाम), तावी (मेडागास्कर), कोनुको (वेनेजुएला), तमराइ (थाइलैंड), चेना (श्रीलंका), लोगन (पश्चिमी अफ्रीका)।

question_en: In which of the following awards, winners are awarded a copy of a golden statuette as a trophy?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस पुरस्कार में विजेताओं को ट्रॉफी के रूप में स्वर्ण प्रतिमा की एक प्रति प्रदान की जाती है?
explanation_en: The Academy Award of Merit (the Oscar), first given in 1929, honours achievement in film; winners receive a copy of the golden statuette.
explanation_hi: एकेडमी अवॉर्ड ऑफ मेरिट (ऑस्कर) फिल्म उद्योग की उपलब्धियों हेतु 1929 से दिया जाता है; विजेताओं को स्वर्ण प्रतिमा की प्रति मिलती है।

question_en: High pointed arches and use of stained glasses are the features of which of the following styles of architecture?
question_hi: ऊँचे नुकीले मेहराब और रंगीन शीशों का प्रयोग निम्नलिखित में से किस वास्तुकला शैली की विशेषताएँ हैं?
explanation_en: Gothic architecture developed in Europe; its features include pointed arches, stained glass, flying buttresses and ribbed vaults (e.g. Notre-Dame de Paris, Salisbury Cathedral).
explanation_hi: गोथिक शैली यूरोप में विकसित हुई; नुकीले मेहराब, रंगीन शीशे, उड़ते बट्रेस व रिब्ड वाल्ट इसकी विशेषताएँ हैं (जैसे नोट्रे-डेम, पेरिस; सैलिसबरी कैथेड्रल)।

question_en: The first World Social Forum (WSF) meeting was organised in Porto Alegre, Brazil in which year?
question_hi: प्रथम विश्व सामाजिक मंच (डब्ल्यूएसएफ) की बैठक का आयोजन ब्राज़ील के पोर्टो एलेग्रे में किस वर्ष किया गया था?
explanation_en: The first WSF met in Porto Alegre in 2001 as a counter to the World Economic Forum, promoting alternative answers to global economic and social issues.
explanation_hi: प्रथम WSF बैठक 2001 में पोर्टो एलेग्रे में हुई; यह विश्व आर्थिक मंच के विरोध में वैकल्पिक समाधानों को बढ़ावा देने हेतु थी।

question_en: Durand Line separates Afghanistan from which of the following countries?
question_hi: डूरंड रेखा अफगानिस्तान को निम्नलिखित में से किस देश से अलग करती है?
explanation_en: The Durand Line (about 2640 km) separates Afghanistan and Pakistan; it was fixed in 1893 by Mortimer Durand and Abdur Rahman Khan as the British India–Afghanistan boundary.
explanation_hi: डूरंड रेखा (लगभग 2640 किमी) अफगानिस्तान को पाकिस्तान से अलग करती है; 1893 में मोर्टिमर डूरंड और अब्दुर रहमान खान द्वारा निर्धारित।

question_en: Which of the following ratio is an indicator of fiscal performance?
question_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा अनुपात राजकोषीय निष्पादन का सूचक है?
explanation_en: The tax-to-GDP ratio indicates fiscal performance; it shows the government's command over resources through taxes, which carry no obligation of direct service.
explanation_hi: कर-जीडीपी अनुपात राजकोषीय निष्पादन का सूचक है; यह करों के माध्यम से संसाधनों पर सरकार की पहुँच दर्शाता है।

question_en: Which of the following is not a part of the United Nations structure?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संयुक्त राष्ट्र संरचना का भाग नहीं है?
explanation_en: The UN has six principal organs: General Assembly, Security Council, Economic and Social Council, Trusteeship Council, International Court of Justice and Secretariat. There is no Education Council.
explanation_hi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र के 6 अंग हैं: आम सभा, सुरक्षा परिषद, आर्थिक और सामाजिक परिषद, न्यास परिषद, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय और सचिवालय। शिक्षा परिषद इसका भाग नहीं है।

question_en: In some mountains, there are permanently frozen rivers of ice. What this ice is called?
question_hi: कुछ पहाड़ों में स्थायी रूप से जमी बर्फ की नदियाँ हैं। इस बर्फ को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: Glaciers are large permanent masses of ice formed on land that move downslope under gravity; they are sensitive climate indicators and major freshwater reserves.
explanation_hi: ग्लेशियर भूमि पर बने स्थायी बर्फ के विशाल संग्रह हैं जो गुरुत्व के कारण ढलान पर बहते हैं; ये मीठे पानी के महत्वपूर्ण भंडार हैं।

question_en: When does the financial year of India begin?
question_hi: भारत का वित्तीय वर्ष कब शुरू होता है?
explanation_en: India's financial year runs from 1 April to 31 March (e.g. 1 April 2024 – 31 March 2025) and is used for accounts, budgeting and taxation.
explanation_hi: भारत का वित्तीय वर्ष 1 अप्रैल से 31 मार्च तक होता है (जैसे 1 अप्रैल 2024 से 31 मार्च 2025)।

question_en: Which of the following books was written by Leo Tolstoy?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी पुस्तक लियो टॉलस्टॉय द्वारा लिखी गई थी?
explanation_en: Anna Karenina – Leo Tolstoy; Rights of Man – Thomas Paine; Utopia – Thomas More; Decameron – Giovanni Boccaccio.
explanation_hi: अन्ना कॅरेनिना – लियो टॉलस्टॉय; राइट्स ऑफ मैन – थॉमस पेन; यूटोपिया – थॉमस मूर; डेकामेरॉन – जियोवानी बोकाचियो।

question_en: The Second World War known as WWII, lasted for which of the following durations?
question_hi: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध जिसे WWII के नाम से जाना जाता है, निम्नलिखित में से किस अवधि तक चला?
explanation_en: WWII lasted from 1939 to 1945, fought between the Axis (Germany, Japan, Italy) and the Allies (chiefly Britain, France, USSR, USA).
explanation_hi: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध 1939 से 1945 तक धुरी राष्ट्रों (जर्मनी, जापान, इटली) और मित्र राष्ट्रों (ब्रिटेन, फ्रांस, सोवियत संघ, अमेरिका) के बीच चला।

question_en: Which of the following is related to "Viticulture"?
question_hi: "विटीकल्चर" का सम्बन्ध निम्नलिखित में से किससे है?
explanation_en: Viticulture – grapes; Sericulture – silk; Apiculture – honey; Pisciculture – fish.
explanation_hi: विटीकल्चर – अंगूर; सेरीकल्चर – रेशम; एपिकल्चर – शहद; पिसीकल्चर – मछली उत्पादन।

question_en: In which year the restoration work of Sanchi stupa started?
question_hi: सांची स्तूप का जीर्णोद्धार कार्य किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ था?
explanation_en: Per the solution, restoration of the Sanchi stupa began in 1881 (it credits ASI Director-General Sir John Marshall). It is among India's oldest Buddhist monuments and became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1989.
explanation_hi: हल के अनुसार सांची स्तूप का जीर्णोद्धार 1881 में शुरू हुआ (सर जॉन मार्शल का नाम दिया गया है)। 1989 में यह यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल बना।

question_en: In which year did Dost Mohammad Khan build Bhopal his capital?
question_hi: दोस्त मोहम्मद खान ने किस वर्ष भोपाल को अपनी राजधानी बनाया था?
explanation_en: Dost Mohammad Khan, an Afghan who ruled from 1707 to March 1728, made Bhopal his capital in 1722.
explanation_hi: दोस्त मोहम्मद खान (अफगानी, शासनकाल 1707 – मार्च 1728) ने 1722 में भोपाल को अपनी राजधानी बनाया।

question_en: The inscription from the cave of Keoti is engraved in ____.
question_hi: क्योटी/केवटी की गुफा का शिलालेख ____ में उत्कीर्ण है।
explanation_en: Per the key, the Keoti cave inscription is in Pali. The cave is in Sirmaur tehsil of Rewa district; Keoti fort was built by Nagmal Dev.
explanation_hi: केवटी गुफा का शिलालेख पाली भाषा में है; गुफा रीवा जिले की सिरमौर तहसील में है। केवटी किला नागमल देव ने बनवाया।

question_en: In which style was the Rangmahal Palace at Hatta built?
question_hi: हट्टा के रंगमहल पैलेस किस शैली में बनाया गया था?
explanation_en: The two-storey Rangmahal at Hatta, on the Sunar river in Damoh district, is built in Maratha style with lime and rubble masonry.
explanation_hi: हट्टा (दमोह जिला, सुनार नदी तट) का दो मंजिला रंगमहल मराठा शैली में चूने व मलबे की चिनाई से बना है।

question_en: Which of the following is the largest opium producing district of Madhya Pradesh in the country?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन देश में मध्य प्रदेश का सबसे बड़ा अफीम उत्पादक जिला है?
explanation_en: Neemuch is MP's largest opium-producing district; it hosts the country's second opium and alkaloid factory, running since 1 April 1935.
explanation_hi: नीमच म.प्र. का सबसे बड़ा अफीम उत्पादक जिला है; यहाँ 1 अप्रैल 1935 से देश का दूसरा अफीम व एल्कलॉयड संयंत्र कार्यरत है।

question_en: Which of the following countries is related to the Federal Reserve System?
question_hi: फेडरल रिज़र्व सिस्टम का सम्बन्ध निम्नलिखित में से किस देश से है?
explanation_en: The Federal Reserve System is the central bank of the USA, created on 23 December 1913 under the Federal Reserve Act to manage and stabilise the money supply.
explanation_hi: फेडरल रिज़र्व सिस्टम अमेरिका का केंद्रीय बैंक है, जिसकी स्थापना 23 दिसंबर 1913 को फेडरल रिज़र्व अधिनियम के तहत हुई।

question_en: Which actress has been honoured with 'Best Actress' award at the 67th National Awards ceremony?
question_hi: 67वें राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार समारोह में किस अभिनेत्री को 'सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेत्री' के पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया है?
explanation_en: At the 67th National Film Awards, Kangana Ranaut won Best Actress for 'Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi'; Best Actor was shared by Manoj Bajpayee and Dhanush.
explanation_hi: 67वें राष्ट्रीय फिल्म पुरस्कार में कंगना रनौत को 'मणिकर्णिका' हेतु सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेत्री; सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेता मनोज बाजपेयी व धनुष।

question_en: In which year was the 50th anniversary of Annie Awards celebrated?
question_hi: एनी अवॉर्ड की 50वीं वर्षगाँठ किस वर्ष मनाई गई?
explanation_en: The 50th Annie Awards were held on 25 February 2023 in Los Angeles; the first Annie Awards were presented in November 1972.
explanation_hi: 50वें एनी अवॉर्ड 25 फरवरी 2023 को लॉस एंजिल्स में मनाए गए; पहले एनी अवॉर्ड नवंबर 1972 में दिए गए।

question_en: The defect in which hormone can result in diabetes?
question_hi: किस हॉर्मोन के दोष से मधुमेह हो सकता है?
explanation_en: Insulin, a peptide hormone made by beta cells of the pancreatic islets of Langerhans, lowers blood sugar; a defect in it causes diabetes.
explanation_hi: इंसुलिन (अग्नाशय के लैंगरहैंस द्वीप की बीटा कोशिकाओं द्वारा निर्मित पेप्टाइड हॉर्मोन) रक्त शर्करा घटाता है; इसके दोष से मधुमेह होता है।

question_en: ____ of pain killers may damage the nervous system, excretory system, liver.
question_hi: दर्द निवारक दवाओं के ____ तंत्रिका तंत्र, उत्सर्जन प्रणाली, यकृत को नुकसान पहुंचा सकते हैं।
explanation_en: Overuse of painkillers can damage the nervous system, excretory system and liver; a severe overdose can be fatal.
explanation_hi: दर्द निवारक दवाओं का जरूरत से ज्यादा सेवन तंत्रिका तंत्र, उत्सर्जन प्रणाली व यकृत को नुकसान पहुँचाता है; अत्यधिक सेवन जानलेवा हो सकता है।

question_en: Energy is measured in ____, the same unit as Work.
question_hi: ऊर्जा को ____ में मापा जाता है, जो कार्य के समान इकाई है।
explanation_en: The SI unit of both energy and work is the joule: work = force × distance = newton × metre.
explanation_hi: ऊर्जा व कार्य दोनों का SI मात्रक जूल है: कार्य = बल × दूरी = न्यूटन × मीटर।

question_en: ____ has no direction.
question_hi: ____ की कोई दिशा नहीं है।
explanation_en: Power is a scalar — the rate of energy transfer (P = work/time), SI unit watt — so it has no direction.
explanation_hi: शक्ति एक अदिश राशि है (P = कार्य/समय), मात्रक वाट; अतः इसकी कोई दिशा नहीं होती।

question_en: Assertion (A): Human beings have an important place in the environment. Reason (R): Humans use natural resources for their existence, but over-exploitation of the resources may lead to loss of resources. Examine both statements and choose the correct option.
question_hi: अभिकथन (A): पर्यावरण में मनुष्य का महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है। कारण (R): मनुष्य अपने अस्तित्व के लिए प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का उपयोग करता है, लेकिन संसाधनों के अत्यधिक दोहन से संसाधनों की हानि हो सकती है। दोनों कथनों की जांच कर सही विकल्प चुनें।
option_a_en: Both A and R are true
option_b_en: Both A and R are false
option_c_en: A is true, but R is false
option_d_en: A is false, but R is true
option_a_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं
option_b_hi: A और R दोनों असत्य हैं
option_c_hi: A सत्य है लेकिन R असत्य है
option_d_hi: A असत्य है लेकिन R सत्य है
explanation_en: Humans hold an important place as they use water, minerals, forests etc. to survive, and over-exploitation does cause resource loss — both statements are true.
explanation_hi: मनुष्य अस्तित्व के लिए जल, खनिज, वन आदि संसाधनों का उपयोग करता है और अत्यधिक दोहन से संसाधनों की हानि होती है — दोनों कथन सत्य हैं।

question_en: Which one does not cause air pollution?
question_hi: कौन-सा वायु प्रदूषण का कारण नहीं बनता है?
option_b_en: Industries release harmful gases and smoke.
option_b_hi: हानिकारक गैसें और धुंआ छोड़ने वाले उद्योग।
explanation_en: Per the key, dumping of garbage is treated as not causing air pollution, whereas vehicle smoke, industrial emissions, crackers, open waste burning, forest fires and fossil-fuel burning do.
explanation_hi: उत्तर कुंजी के अनुसार कचरे का राशिपतन वायु प्रदूषण का कारण नहीं है; वाहन, उद्योग, पटाखे, खुले में कूड़ा जलाना, जंगल की आग आदि वायु प्रदूषण करते हैं।

question_en: Assertion (A): Nowadays, we are observing environmental degradation everywhere. Reason (R): To prevent diseases like asthma, heart problems, etc. Prevention of diseases leads to a healthy environment and healthy living beings. Examine both statements and choose the correct option.
question_hi: अभिकथन (A): आजकल हम हर जगह पर्यावरणीय क्षरण देख रहे हैं। कारण (R): दमा, हृदय रोग आदि जैसे रोगों से बचाव के लिए रोगों की रोकथाम से स्वस्थ वातावरण और स्वस्थ प्राणी बनते हैं। दोनों कथनों की जांच कर सही विकल्प चुनें।
option_a_en: Both A and R are true
option_b_en: Both A and R are false
option_c_en: A is true, but R is false
option_d_en: A is false, but R is true
option_a_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं
option_b_hi: A और R दोनों असत्य हैं
option_c_hi: A सत्य है लेकिन R असत्य है
option_d_hi: A असत्य है लेकिन R सत्य है
explanation_en: Environmental degradation (earthquakes, landslides, forest fires, drought, floods) is visible everywhere, and a healthy environment helps prevent asthma, heart disease etc. — both are taken as true.
explanation_hi: हर जगह पर्यावरणीय क्षरण दिख रहा है; स्वस्थ वातावरण से दमा, हृदय रोग आदि से बचाव होता है — दोनों कथन सत्य माने गए हैं।

question_en: What is the process of rapidly changing water from a liquid to vapour using heat?
question_hi: ऊष्मा का उपयोग करके जल को द्रव से वाष्प में तेजी से बदलने की प्रक्रिया क्या है?
explanation_en: Per the key, changing water from liquid to vapour using heat is evaporation. Condensation is vapour turning to liquid; sublimation is a solid turning directly to gas (e.g. camphor).
explanation_hi: उत्तर के अनुसार ऊष्मा से जल का द्रव से वाष्प बनना वाष्पीकरण है। संघनन में वाष्प द्रव बनती है; ऊर्ध्वपातन में ठोस सीधे गैस बनता है (जैसे कपूर)।
note: Rapid liquid-to-vapour change using heat is arguably boiling (D); key and worked solution both give (B).

question_en: Which of the following chromosomal combination is responsible for masculinity in a male?
question_hi: पुरुष में पुरुषत्व के लिए निम्न में से कौन-सा गुणसूत्री संयोजन उत्तरदायी है?
explanation_en: Humans have 46 chromosomes; the sex chromosomes X and Y determine sex — males are XY, females XX.
explanation_hi: मनुष्य में 46 गुणसूत्र होते हैं; लिंग X व Y गुणसूत्रों से निर्धारित होता है — पुरुष XY, महिला XX।

question_en: The most preferred wood for the production of cricket bats is ____.
question_hi: क्रिकेट के बल्ले के उत्पादन के लिए सबसे पसंदीदा लकड़ी ____ है।
explanation_en: Willow is preferred because it is light and does not get damaged by the ball's impact.
explanation_hi: विलो की लकड़ी हल्की होती है और गेंद के प्रहार से क्षतिग्रस्त नहीं होती, इसलिए बल्ले हेतु सबसे पसंदीदा है।

question_en: Who is known as the Bird Man of India?
question_hi: बर्ड मैन ऑफ इंडिया के नाम से किसे जाना जाता है?
explanation_en: Dr. Salim Moizuddin Abdul Ali (born 12 November 1896) is called the 'Birdman of India'; he wrote 'The Book of Indian Birds'.
explanation_hi: डॉ. सलीम मोइज़ुद्दीन अब्दुल अली (जन्म 12 नवंबर 1896) 'बर्डमैन ऑफ इंडिया' कहलाते हैं; उन्होंने 'बुक ऑफ इंडियन बर्ड्स' लिखी।

question_en: Vegetative reproduction in mosses is by fragmentation and budding in the ____ Protonema.
question_hi: काई में वानस्पतिक प्रजनन ____ प्रोटोनिमा में विखंडन और मुकुलन द्वारा होता है।
explanation_en: In mosses, vegetative reproduction is by fragmentation and budding of the secondary protonema; the primary protonema develops directly from the spore.
explanation_hi: काई में वानस्पतिक प्रजनन द्वितीयक प्रोटोनिमा में विखंडन व मुकुलन से होता है; प्राथमिक प्रोटोनिमा सीधे बीजाणु से बनता है।

question_en: The strobili bearing microsporophylls and microsporangia are called ____.
question_hi: माइक्रोस्पोरोफिल और माइक्रोस्पोरैंगिया युक्त स्ट्रोबिली को ____ कहा जाता है।
explanation_en: Strobili are cone-like reproductive structures of gymnosperms; those bearing microsporophylls and microsporangia are male strobili.
explanation_hi: स्ट्रोबिली अनावृतबीजी पौधों की शंकु रूपी प्रजनन संरचनाएँ हैं; माइक्रोस्पोरोफिल व माइक्रोस्पोरैंगिया युक्त स्ट्रोबिली नर स्ट्रोबिली हैं।

question_en: Which is not a reproductive organ in terms of a flower?
question_hi: फूल की दृष्टि से कौन-सा जनन अंग नहीं है?
explanation_en: Sepals are small green leaf-like accessory parts at the base of the flower (together the calyx), not reproductive organs; ovary, ovule and style are reproductive parts.
explanation_hi: बाह्यदल फूल के आधार पर स्थित छोटी हरी पत्ती जैसी सहायक संरचनाएँ हैं (कैलिक्स), जनन अंग नहीं; अंडाशय, बीजाणु और वर्तिका जनन भाग हैं।

question_en: Life cycle of a Pinus is called?
question_hi: पाइनस का जीवन चक्र कहलाता है?
explanation_en: Per the key, the Pinus life cycle is diplohaplontic, with a sporophyte phase and a gametophyte phase; the mature sporophyte bears male and female cones.
explanation_hi: उत्तर के अनुसार पाइनस का जीवन चक्र डिप्लोहाप्लोंटिक है, जिसमें स्पोरोफाइट व गैमेटोफाइट दो चरण होते हैं; स्पोरोफाइट नर व मादा शंकु बनाता है।
note: Standard texts (e.g. NCERT) describe gymnosperms such as Pinus as diplontic (B); key and worked solution both give (A).

question_en: Find the number of triangles in the figure.
question_hi: इस आकृति में त्रिभुज की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: Labelling regions 1–4: single-region triangles 1, 2, 3, 4 = 4; two-region triangles (2,3), (3,4) = 2; total = 6.

question_en: Select the letter-cluster that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster. LOGIC : BHFNK :: CLERK : ?
question_hi: उस अक्षर-समूह का चयन करें जो तीसरे अक्षर-समूह से उसी प्रकार संबंधित है जैसे दूसरा अक्षर-समूह, पहले अक्षर-समूह से संबंधित है। LOGIC : BHFNK :: CLERK : ?
explanation_en: Reverse the word and shift each letter by −1: LOGIC → CIGOL → BHFNK. Likewise CLERK → KRELC → JQDKB.
explanation_hi: शब्द को उल्टा लिखकर प्रत्येक अक्षर में −1: LOGIC → CIGOL → BHFNK; उसी प्रकार CLERK → KRELC → JQDKB।

question_en: Select the option/number which is related to 3rd number in the same way as 2nd number is related to 1st number. 326 : 10 :: 253 : ?
question_hi: उस संख्या/विकल्प का चयन करें जो तीसरी संख्या से उसी प्रकार संबंधित है जैसे दूसरी संख्या पहली संख्या से संबंधित है। 326 : 10 :: 253 : ?

question_en: Choose the numbers which is different from others in the group?
question_hi: दिए गए समूह में से विषम संख्या का चयन करें?
explanation_en: Rule: a³ + b² = c. 3³+5² = 52, 1³+4² = 17, 7³+2² = 347, but 1³+2² = 5 ≠ 9, so (a) is odd.

question_en: In the given figure, which Alphabet indicates the Women who are neither Sister nor Grandmother?
question_hi: दी गई आकृति में, कौन-सी वर्णमाला उन महिलाओं को इंगित करती है जो न तो बहन हैं और न ही दादी हैं?
explanation_en: Triangle = sister, circle = women, square = grandmother. Region A lies only inside the circle, so it represents women who are neither sisters nor grandmothers.
explanation_hi: त्रिभुज = बहन, वृत्त = महिला, वर्ग = दादी। A केवल वृत्त में है, अतः A वे महिलाएँ हैं जो न बहन हैं न दादी।

question_en: Find the missing term in the following series. SOFA : RTNPEGZB :: TICKET : ?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित शृंखला में लुप्त पद ज्ञात कीजिए। SOFA : RTNPEGZB :: TICKET : ?
explanation_en: Each letter is replaced by its −1 and +1 neighbours: S→RT, O→NP, F→EG, A→ZB. Likewise T→SU, I→HJ, C→BD, K→JL, E→DF, T→SU = SUHJBDJLDFSU.
explanation_hi: प्रत्येक अक्षर के स्थान पर उसका −1 व +1 अक्षर: S→RT, O→NP, F→EG, A→ZB; उसी प्रकार TICKET → SUHJBDJLDFSU।

question_en: What should come in place of question mark (?) in the following question? EG : DH :: ? : IK
question_hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर क्या मान आना चाहिए? EG : DH :: ? : IK
explanation_en: First letter −1, second letter +1 (E→D, G→H). Working back from IK: I+1 = J, K−1 = J, so ? = JJ.
explanation_hi: पहला अक्षर −1, दूसरा +1 (E→D, G→H)। IK से उल्टा: I+1 = J, K−1 = J, अतः ? = JJ।

question_en: Which is the wrong term in the following series? 6, 13, 19, 22, 58, 31, 180, 40
explanation_en: Two alternating series: 6, 19, 58, … (×3 + 1, so next should be 175) and 13, 22, 31, 40 (+9). Hence 180 is wrong.

question_en: In the following question, a certain series of numbers or letters is given of which one series is empty. Decide which of the alternative series will be used in the blank space that is originally related to the sequence of that series. DE5, EF6, FG7, GH8, ?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में, संख्याओं या अक्षरों की एक निश्चित शृंखला दी गई है, जिसमें से एक शृंखला खाली है। तय करें कि रिक्त स्थान में कौन-सी वैकल्पिक शृंखला आएगी। DE5, EF6, FG7, GH8, ?
explanation_en: Each position increases by 1: D→E→F→G→H, E→F→G→H→I and 5→6→7→8→9, giving HI9.

question_en: A figure analogy is given below. Understand the logic behind it and complete the analogy for the next figure.
question_hi: एक आकृति सादृश्य नीचे दिया गया है। इसके पीछे के तर्क को समझें और अगली आकृति के लिए सादृश्य को पूर्ण करें।
explanation_en: In the first pair the shaded shape rotates 135° anticlockwise and the unshaded shape 135° clockwise; applying the same to the third figure gives option (c).
explanation_hi: पहले सादृश्य में रंगीन आकृति 135° वामावर्त और खाली आकृति 135° दक्षिणावर्त घूमती है; तीसरी आकृति पर यही लागू करने से विकल्प (c) बनता है।

question_en: Select the next figure in the following figure series?
question_hi: निम्नलिखित आकृति शृंखला में अगली आकृति का चयन करें?
explanation_en: Both symbols @ and % move 3 places clockwise at each step, so the next figure is option (b).
explanation_hi: दोनों चिह्न @ तथा % हर चरण में 3 स्थान दक्षिणावर्त खिसकते हैं; अतः अगली आकृति विकल्प (b) है।

question_en: Identify the class that best represents the Venn-diagram.
question_hi: उस वर्ग की पहचान करें जो वेन-आरेख का सबसे अच्छा प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।
explanation_en: Superheroes lie entirely within those having superpower, and some superheroes are men — matching one circle inside a larger one with a third circle overlapping the inner one.
explanation_hi: सभी सुपरहीरो सुपरपावर वाले वर्ग के अंदर हैं और कुछ सुपरहीरो पुरुष हैं — यह आरेख से मेल खाता है।

question_en: How many squares are in the given figure?
question_hi: दी गई आकृति में कितने वर्ग हैं?
explanation_en: Squares: ABCD, JBNE, GBOF, IHGJ, KLMF = 5.
explanation_hi: वर्ग: ABCD, JBNE, GBOF, IHGJ, KLMF = 5।

question_en: How many triangles are in the given figure?
question_hi: दी गई आकृति में कितने त्रिभुज हैं?
explanation_en: Single-region triangles: 5; two-region: (2,8), (2,3) = 2; three-region: (1,8,2), (2,3,6), (3,5,7) = 3; six-region: (1,8,2,3,7,5) = 1; total 11.

question_en: Find the number of triangle in the given figure.
question_hi: दी गई आकृति में त्रिभुज की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: Single-region triangles: 6; two-region: (1,2), (3,4) = 2; total 8.

question_en: If the mirror is placed on the line, then which of the answer figure is the right mirror image of the given figure?
question_hi: यदि एक दर्पण को दर्शाई गई रेखा पर रखा जाये, तो दी गई विकल्प आकृतियों में से कौन-सी सही दर्पण छवि होगी?
explanation_en: With the mirror on line AB, option (c) is the correct mirror image of the figure.
explanation_hi: दर्पण को रेखा AB पर रखने पर विकल्प (c) सही दर्पण छवि है।

question_en: Find the odd word/letters/number pair from the given alternatives.
question_hi: इस प्रश्न में दिए गए विकल्पों में से विषम शब्द/अक्षर/संख्या युग्म चुनिए?

question_en: Two statements are given followed by two conclusions I and II. Consider the statements to be true even if they seem at variance with commonly known facts, and decide which conclusion definitely follows. Statements: (I) Conflicts in mind create tension. (II) Resolution of conflict leads to good mental health. Conclusions: (I) One becomes hefty and strong by resolving one's conflicts. (II) Freedom from conflicts leads to good mental health.
question_hi: दो वक्तव्यों के आगे दो निष्कर्ष I और II दिए गए हैं। दोनों वक्तव्यों को सत्य मानकर तय करें कि कौन-सा निष्कर्ष निश्चित रूप से निकलता है। वक्तव्य: (I) मन में द्वन्द्वों से तनाव पैदा होता है। (II) द्वन्द्व के समाधान से मानसिक स्वास्थ्य अच्छा रहता है। निष्कर्ष: (I) अपने द्वन्द्वों का समाधान करके व्यक्ति बहुत शक्तिशाली और मजबूत हो जाता है। (II) द्वन्द्वों से मुक्ति मानसिक स्वास्थ्य अच्छा बनाती है।
option_c_en: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
option_d_en: Both conclusions I and II follow
option_c_hi: न तो निष्कर्ष I और न ही II निकलता है
option_d_hi: I और II दोनों निष्कर्ष निकलते हैं
explanation_en: Conclusion I (becoming very strong) is not supported by either statement; Conclusion II follows from Statement II.
explanation_hi: निष्कर्ष I किसी कथन से नहीं निकलता; निष्कर्ष II कथन II से निकलता है। अतः केवल II।

question_en: Statement: Should strict action be taken against a person who incites people in the name of religion? Arguments: (I) Yes, because out of fear of strict action they will stop inciting people. (II) No, everyone has the right to talk for their religion. Decide which argument(s) is/are strong.
question_hi: कथन: क्या जो व्यक्ति धर्म के नाम पर लोगों को भड़काते हैं उन पर सख्त कार्यवाही होनी चाहिए? तर्क: (I) हाँ, क्योंकि कार्यवाही के डर से ही वह लोगों को भड़काना बन्द करेंगे। (II) नहीं, व्यक्ति को अपने धर्म के लिए बोलने का अधिकार है। तय करें कि कौन-सा तर्क मजबूत है।
option_c_en: Both arguments I and II are strong
option_d_en: Either argument I or II is strong
option_c_hi: दोनों तर्क I तथा II मजबूत हैं
option_d_hi: या तो तर्क I या II मजबूत है
explanation_en: Fear of strict action deters incitement, so argument I is strong; argument II is not.
explanation_hi: कार्यवाही के डर से भड़काना बंद होगा, अतः तर्क I मजबूत है जबकि II मजबूत नहीं।

question_en: Statement: Should eating non-vegetarian food be allowed in office or public places? Arguments: (I) Yes, eating anything is right of any person. No one has the right to stop this. (II) No, it is not permitted to eat non-veg inside office and public places because it will create problem to those who don't eat non-vegetarian food. Decide which argument(s) is/are strong.
question_hi: कथन: क्या कार्यालय या सार्वजनिक स्थानों पर माँसाहारी खाना खाने की अनुमति देनी चाहिए? तर्क: (I) हाँ, कुछ भी खाना व्यक्ति का मौलिक अधिकार है। कोई इसको रोक नहीं सकता है। (II) नहीं, ऑफिस या सार्वजनिक स्थानों पर इसे खाने की अनुमति नहीं देनी चाहिए क्योंकि इससे उन लोगों को परेशानी हो सकती है जो माँसाहार भोजन ना खाते हों। तय करें कि कौन-सा तर्क मजबूत है।
option_c_en: Both arguments I and II are strong
option_d_en: Either argument I or II is strong
option_c_hi: दोनों तर्क I तथा II मजबूत हैं
option_d_hi: या तो तर्क I या II मजबूत है
explanation_en: Per the key, only argument II is strong, since it may inconvenience those who do not eat non-vegetarian food.
explanation_hi: उत्तर के अनुसार केवल तर्क II मजबूत है, क्योंकि इससे माँसाहार न खाने वालों को परेशानी हो सकती है।

question_en: The value of a machine depreciates every year by 20%. If the present value of the machine be Rs. 160000, what was its value (in rupees) last year?
question_hi: एक मशीन का मूल्य प्रत्येक वर्ष 20% घट जाता है। यदि मशीन का वर्तमान मूल्य 160000 रुपये है, तो पिछले वर्ष इसका मूल्य (रुपये में) क्या था?

question_en: 96% of the population of a village is 23040. The total population of the village is?
question_hi: एक गाँव की 96% जनसंख्या 23040 है। गाँव की कुल जनसंख्या है?

question_en: On selling 50 pens at Rs 1000, there is a loss equal to the cost price of 30 pens. What is the cost price of a pen?
question_hi: 50 पेन को 1000 रुपये पर बेचने पर 30 पेन के क्रय मूल्य के बराबर हानि होती है। एक पेन का क्रय मूल्य क्या है?

question_en: The difference between selling prices of two cameras at profits of 9% and 10% is Rs. 40. Find the cost price of the camera and the selling prices of the two cameras.
question_hi: 9% और 10% के लाभ पर दो कैमरों के विक्रय मूल्य के बीच का अंतर 40 रुपये है। कैमरों का क्रय मूल्य और दोनों कैमरों का विक्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

question_en: A sum of Rs. 20000 is lent partly at 2% and the remaining at 10% per annum. If the average yearly rate of interest is 9.2% then what will be the two parts?
question_hi: 20000 रुपये की राशि को आंशिक रूप से 2% और शेष 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से उधार दिया जाता है। यदि ब्याज की औसत वार्षिक दर 9.2% है, तो दो भाग क्या होंगे?

question_en: At what rate percent per annum will sum of money double in 20 years?
question_hi: किस दर प्रतिशत प्रति वर्ष 20 वर्षों में दोगुना धन होगा?

question_en: What will come in place of question mark (?) in the following question? (41/15) × (4/10) + (5/21) × 63 = 15 + ?/75
In exam of 8th class there are 30 students 30% students failed. How many students passed in class 8th?
question_hi: 8वीं कक्षा की परीक्षा में 30 विद्यार्थी हैं, 30% विद्यार्थी अनुत्तीर्ण हैं। आठवीं कक्षा में कितने विद्यार्थी उत्तीर्ण हुए?

question_en: If a:b = 9:10 and b:c = 3:5, then find a:b:c
question_hi: यदि a:b = 9:10 और b:c = 3:5 है, तो a:b:c का मान क्या होगा?
explanation_en: Equalise b: a:b = 27:30 and b:c = 30:50 ⇒ a:b:c = 27:30:50.

question_en: Out of the three numbers, the ratio between the first number and the second number is 6 : 7 and the ratio between the 2nd and the 3rd number is 7 : 13 and the sum of three numbers is 16224. Find the first number:
question_hi: तीन संख्याओं में से, पहली संख्या और दूसरी संख्या के बीच का अनुपात 6 : 7 है तथा दूसरी और तीसरी संख्या के बीच का अनुपात 7 : 13 है और तीनों संख्याओं का योग 16224 है। पहली संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation_en: Ratio 6:7:13 (sum 26); first number = 6/26 × 16224 = 3744.

question_en: Sarah lent some amount to Aarav. She received Rs 4,900 and Rs 5,488 at the end of 3rd and 4th year respectively at compound interest on certain sum. Find the rate of interest at which Aarav borrowed from Sarah.
question_hi: सारा ने आरव को कुछ रकम उधार दी थी। उसे एक निश्चित राशि पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर तीसरे और चौथे वर्ष के अंत में क्रमशः 4,900 रुपये और 5,488 रुपये प्राप्त हुए। वह ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए जिस पर आरव ने सारा से उधार लिया था।
explanation_en: Dividing consecutive amounts: 5488/4900 = 1 + R/100 ⇒ R = 588/4900 × 100 = 12%.

question_en: A bank offers 10% compound interest calculated on half-yearly basis. A customer deposits Rs. 3200 each on first week of January and first week of July of a year. At the end of the year the amount he would gain by way of interest?
question_hi: एक बैंक 10% चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की पेशकश छमाही आधार पर करता है। एक ग्राहक एक वर्ष में जनवरी के पहले सप्ताह तथा जुलाई के पहले सप्ताह, प्रत्येक में 3200 रुपये का निवेश करता है। एक साल के अंत में वह राशि ज्ञात करें, जो वह ब्याज के माध्यम से प्राप्त करेगा?

question_en: After cutting the price of all Apple phones by 15 percent, its sales have increased by 25 percent. So what was increase in total revenue?
question_hi: एप्पल के सभी फोन की कीमत में 15 फीसदी की कटौती के बाद इसकी बिक्री 25 फीसदी बढ़ गई है, तो कुल राजस्व में कितनी वृद्धि हुई?

question_en: Rajesh invested Rs.8000 in the business of juice shop. If it flourished rapidly and bought a 40% profit every year. Instead of taking out the profit, it was added to the capital every year. What was his total investment in the business at the end of 3 years?
question_hi: राजेश ने जूस की दुकान के कारोबार में 8000 रुपये का निवेश किया। यदि यह तेजी से फलता-फूलता है और प्रत्येक वर्ष 40% लाभ होता है। लाभ निकालने के बजाय इसे प्रत्येक वर्ष पूँजी में जोड़ा जाता है। 3 वर्ष के अंत में व्यवसाय में उसका कुल निवेश क्या था?

question_en: Divide 243 kg weight in three parts such that half of the first part, one-third of the second part and one-fourth of the third part are equal.
question_hi: 243 किलोग्राम वजन को तीन भागों में इस प्रकार बांटें कि पहले भाग का आधा, दूसरे भाग का एक तिहाई और तीसरे भाग का एक-चौथाई बराबर हो जाएं।

question_en: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 27 ÷ 3 × 17 − 128 + 4 = 46
question_hi: दिए गए समीकरण को सही बनाने के लिए किन दो चिह्नों को आपस में बदला जाना चाहिए? 27 ÷ 3 × 17 − 128 + 4 = 46

question_en: Which of the following cube in the answer figure cannot be made based on the unfolded cube in the question figure?
question_hi: उत्तर आकृति में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा घन, प्रश्न आकृति में खुले घन के आधार पर नहीं बनाया जा सकता है?
option_a_en: Cube: TN top, KG front, KM side
option_b_en: Cube: G top, KM front, TN side
option_c_en: Cube: GM top, CM front, KG side
option_d_en: Cube: KM top, GM front, KG side
option_a_hi: घन: TN ऊपर, KG सामने, KM बगल
option_b_hi: घन: G ऊपर, KM सामने, TN बगल
option_c_hi: घन: GM ऊपर, CM सामने, KG बगल
option_d_hi: घन: KM ऊपर, GM सामने, KG बगल
explanation_en: From the net, opposite faces are CM–KM, GM–G and KG–TN. Opposite faces can never be seen together; option (a) shows TN and KG together, so it is impossible.
explanation_hi: खुले घन से विपरीत फलक: CM–KM, GM–G, KG–TN। विपरीत फलक एक साथ नहीं दिख सकते; विकल्प (a) में TN व KG साथ हैं, अतः संभव नहीं।

question_en: Choose the correct option in order to balance the following equation. 21_3_47_3_107
question_hi: निम्नलिखित समीकरण को संतुलित करने के लिए सही विकल्प चुनें। 21_3_47_3_107

question_en: On what dates of May 1993 did Sunday fall?
question_hi: मई 1993 की किन तारीखों को रविवार पड़ा?
explanation_en: Odd days up to 2 May 1993: 1600 yrs = 0, 300 yrs = 1, 92 yrs (23 leap + 69 ordinary) = 115 → 3, 1 Jan–2 May = 10 → 3; total 7 → 0 = Sunday. So Sundays fell on 2, 9, 16, 23, 30 May.

question_en: If 1 March is Saturday, then 1st April will be?
question_hi: यदि 1 मार्च शनिवार है, तो 1 अप्रैल होगा?
explanation_en: 1 March to 1 April is 31 days = 3 odd days; Saturday + 3 = Tuesday.
explanation_hi: 1 मार्च से 1 अप्रैल तक 31 दिन = 3 विषम दिन; शनिवार + 3 = मंगलवार।

question_en: At what time between 2 to 3 O'clock minute and hour hand will be at right angle to each other or makes 90° angle?
question_hi: 2 से 3 बजे के बीच किस समय मिनट और घंटे की सुई एक दूसरे से समकोण पर होंगी या 90° का कोण बनाएंगी?
explanation_en: Minutes past 2 = (2/11)(90° ± 60°) = 27 3/11 or 5 5/11; the listed option is 2:27 3/11.

question_en: What angle is made by minute hand in 55 seconds?
question_hi: मिनट की सुई 55 सेकंड में कितना कोण बनाती है?
explanation_en: The minute hand moves 6° per minute ⇒ 6 × 55/60 = 5.5°.

question_en: In the following equation, select correct combination of mathematical signs to replace A and balance the equation. 957 A 11 A 19 A 4 A 11
question_hi: निम्नलिखित समीकरण में, A को प्रतिस्थापित करने और समीकरण को संतुलित करने के लिए गणितीय चिह्नों के सही संयोजन का चयन करें। 957 A 11 A 19 A 4 A 11

question_en: If rose is called lily, lily is called sunflower, sunflower is called lotus, lotus is called gladiola and gladiola is called plant. Which of the following is our national flower?
question_hi: यदि गुलाब को लिली कहा जाता है, लिली को सूरजमुखी कहा जाता है, सूरजमुखी को कमल कहा जाता है, कमल को ग्लेडियोला कहा जाता है और ग्लेडियोला को पौधा कहा जाता है। निम्नलिखित में से हमारा राष्ट्रीय फूल कौन-सा है?
explanation_en: The national flower is the lotus, and lotus is called gladiola.
explanation_hi: हमारा राष्ट्रीय फूल कमल है और कमल को ग्लेडियोला कहा गया है।

question_en: If sour is called tangy, tangy is called strong, strong is called mild, mild is called sweet and sweet is called salty. What is the taste of sugar?
question_hi: यदि खट्टे को तीखा कहा जाता है, तीखे को मजबूत कहा जाता है, मजबूत को हल्का कहा जाता है, हल्के को मीठा कहा जाता है और मीठे को नमकीन कहा जाता है। चीनी का स्वाद क्या है?
explanation_en: Sugar tastes sweet, and sweet is called salty.
explanation_hi: चीनी का स्वाद मीठा है और मीठे को नमकीन कहा गया है।

question_en: Find the next term in the series. A, C, ?, G, I
question_hi: शृंखला का अगला पद ज्ञात करें। A, C, ?, G, I
explanation_en: +2 each step: A, C, E, G, I.
explanation_hi: प्रत्येक चरण +2: A, C, E, G, I।

question_en: Arrange the following words as per order in the dictionary. (a) Spine (b) Spinal (c) Spinner (d) Spinet (e) Spindle
question_hi: निम्नलिखित शब्दों को शब्दकोश में दिए गए क्रम के अनुसार लिखिए? (a) Spine (b) Spinal (c) Spinner (d) Spinet (e) Spindle
explanation_en: Dictionary order: Spinal, Spindle, Spine, Spinet, Spinner = (b), (e), (a), (d), (c).
explanation_hi: शब्दकोश क्रम: Spinal, Spindle, Spine, Spinet, Spinner = (b), (e), (a), (d), (c)।

question_en: Which one word can be formed from the following letters? a b n q e u t s
question_hi: निम्नलिखित अक्षरों से कौन-सा एक शब्द बनाया जा सकता है? a b n q e u t s
explanation_en: Rearranging the letters gives BANQUETS.
explanation_hi: अक्षरों को व्यवस्थित करने पर BANQUETS बनता है।

question_en: If DIG is coded as 25 and CUT is coded as 49, then how will KICK be coded as?
question_hi: यदि DIG को 25 के रूप में और CUT को 49 के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है तो KICK को किस रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाएगा?

question_en: If TEMPLE is coded as ELPMET, then how will CHURCH be coded as?
question_hi: यदि TEMPLE को ELPMET के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है तो CHURCH को कैसे कूटबद्ध किया जाएगा?
explanation_en: The word is written in reverse: CHURCH → HCRUHC.
explanation_hi: शब्द को उल्टा लिखा जाता है: CHURCH → HCRUHC।

question_en: A, B and C start at the same time in the same direction to run around a circular stadium. A completes a round in 54 seconds, B in 63 seconds and C in 72 seconds, all starting at the same point. After what time will they again at the starting point?
question_hi: A, B और C एक ही समय में एक ही दिशा में एक गोलाकार स्टेडियम के चारों ओर दौड़ना शुरू करते हैं। A एक चक्कर 54 सेकंड में, B 63 सेकंड में और C, 72 सेकंड में पूरा करता है, सभी एक ही बिंदु से शुरू करते हैं। कितने समय के बाद वे फिर से शुरुआती बिंदु पर आएंगे?

question_en: The ratio of two numbers is 5 : 6 and their H.C.F. is 7. Find their L.C.M.
question_hi: दो संख्याओं का अनुपात 5 : 6 है और उनका एच.सी.एफ. 7 है, उनका एल.सी.एम. होगा–
explanation_en: The numbers are 35 and 42, so LCM = 5 × 6 × 7 = 210, which matches none of the options.
note: ANSWER DISPUTED. Worked solution gives 210 (no matching option); the commission's official key marked 180 (option B).

question_en: If HCF of two numbers, 60 and 75, is 15. Then find their LCM.
question_hi: यदि दो संख्याओं, 60 और 75 का HCF 15 है, तो उनका LCM ज्ञात कीजिए।

question_en: If 5^(x+3) = 25^(3x−4), then the value of x is.
Suppose 4^a = 5, 5^b = 6, 6^c = 7, 7^d = 8, then the value of abcd is
explanation_en: Chaining the powers: 4^(abcd) = 8 ⇒ 2^(2abcd) = 2³ ⇒ abcd = 3/2.
explanation_hi: घातों को जोड़ने पर 4^(abcd) = 8 ⇒ 2^(2abcd) = 2³ ⇒ abcd = 3/2।

question_en: The value of: (6² + 13)/7 + 5 × 3 − 2
Two trains started from a station, at the same time in the same direction, at speed of 70 km/h and 60 km/h. What will be the distance between the two trains after 6 h?
question_hi: एक स्टेशन से दो ट्रेनों ने एक ही दिशा में, एक ही समय पर क्रमशः 70 किमी./घंटा और 60 किमी./घंटा की गति से चलना शुरू किया। 6 घंटे के बाद ट्रेनों के बीच की दूरी क्या होगी?
explanation_en: Relative speed = 70 − 60 = 10 km/h; distance after 6 h = 60 km.
explanation_hi: सापेक्षिक चाल = 10 किमी/घंटा; 6 घंटे में दूरी = 60 किमी।

question_en: The length of a rectangle is two and half times their width. If length is decreased by 3 cm and width is increased by 2 cm then area is increased by 16 cm². What is the perimeter of the original rectangle?
